dtt.title: Data-to-text reporting
dtt.purpose: Express facts, relationships, and scope from structured input in report text.

skills.name: Discretionary narrative focus and coverage
skills.action: Record the report’s chosen narrative focus and its discretionary handling of other available information without turning that choice into a coverage rule.

applicability.description: Observations describing a report’s discretionary choice of subject matter, amount of detail, and inclusion or non-inclusion of available case or administrative information.

context.scope_limits: Includes topic choice, foregrounding, compression, and optional omission—including administrative, outcome, financial, technical, and location details. Does not require any particular fact, opening position, completeness level, or omission; does not infer that unstated facts are false or irrelevant. A distinct, positively attempted relation or state distinction would need its own assessable rule.

evaluation.attempt_definition: An account positively selects, foregrounds, limits, or omits some topic or record detail in favor of another topic or a chosen scope.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: these observations do not specify a report-observable relation or distinction with a defensible pass/fail boundary.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: a different coherent selection, emphasis, ordering, or coverage choice cannot fail this observation; missing optional facts are not failures.

extensions.scope_limits: Includes topic choice, foregrounding, compression, and optional omission—including administrative, outcome, financial, technical, and location details. Does not require any particular fact, opening position, completeness level, or omission; does not infer that unstated facts are false or irrelevant. A distinct, positively attempted relation or state distinction would need its own assessable rule.

skills.name: Resolve a reference to the intended prior matter
skills.action: When explicitly referring back or forward to a matter, make clear which previously introduced or subsequently described matter the reference identifies.

applicability.description: A report explicitly uses a backward or forward reference to an already introduced action, instrument, document, event, provision, requirement, result, or other specific matter.

context.scope_limits: Omission of a reference is not a failure. Do not require any specific pronoun, abbreviation, repeated name, or literal TRAIN detail.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses wording that points to a specific previously introduced matter, or explicitly points forward to its later explanation. Merely repeating the topic or naming the matter is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The reference lets a reader identify the intended matter from report context and preserves the relationship asserted to it.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted reference has no recoverable target, points to a different matter, or conflates distinct matters so the stated relationship cannot be determined.

extensions.scope_limits: Omission of a reference is not a failure. Do not require any specific pronoun, abbreviation, repeated name, or literal TRAIN detail.

skills.name: Preserve entity and role distinctions in references
skills.action: Use a reference that connects an action or status to the intended entity without collapsing distinct entities or roles.

applicability.description: A report uses a reference that links an actor, group, facility, product, agency, permit, or other entity to an action, obligation, or outcome, especially where those referents could be confused.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer relationships from fields alone or require a role label, pronoun, possessive, group expression, or any particular coverage choice.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report explicitly uses a pronoun, role label, collective expression, possessive, or shared subject to identify an entity in a proposition. A general topic mention without an attempted entity-to-proposition link is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The reference identifies the intended entity or group and preserves any distinctions the report makes between parties, facilities, products, instruments, or roles.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted reference assigns the action or relationship to the wrong entity, merges entities or parties the text otherwise distinguishes, or leaves competing referents unresolved.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer relationships from fields alone or require a role label, pronoun, possessive, group expression, or any particular coverage choice.

skills.name: Optional reference-chain and naming choices
skills.action: The source observations suggest optional names, role labels, pronouns, possessives, descriptive phrases, or repeated identifiers for continuity.

applicability.description: The report contains repeated mentions or a continuing topic for which a writer could choose names, role labels, pronouns, or other references.

context.scope_limits: A clear coherent alternative—including repeating a name or omitting a short reference—is acceptable. Simple entity naming and preferred reference style are not assessed.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report chooses to repeat, shorten, or vary a reference to a party, person, facility, topic, or subject without asserting a specific disputed entity-to-action relationship.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not scored.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not scored: these observations express optional naming, continuity, or reference-form preferences without a sufficiently distinct report-observable pass/fail boundary.

extensions.scope_limits: A clear coherent alternative—including repeating a name or omitting a short reference—is acceptable. Simple entity naming and preferred reference style are not assessed.

skills.name: Optional repetition reduction
skills.action: The source observations suggest optional compression of repeated names, subjects, amounts, or descriptions.

applicability.description: The report repeats an entity, name, amount, subject, or other information that could be stated once or compressed.

context.scope_limits: Do not penalize repetition or require omission. Where a report expressly distinguishes categories or entities, that distinction is assessable only under a relevant eligible relational operation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report reduces or retains repeated wording or information without making a separate, explicit claim about the identity or category of the repeated item.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not scored.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not scored: optional compression or repetition alone does not establish an assessable transformation boundary.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not penalize repetition or require omission. Where a report expressly distinguishes categories or entities, that distinction is assessable only under a relevant eligible relational operation.

skills.name: Optional abbreviation and short-form setup
skills.action: The source observations suggest optional full-name-plus-short-form introductions and later reuse.

applicability.description: A report could introduce an abbreviation, parenthetical label, or shortened name for a term, entity, instrument, agency, or statute.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a short form, a particular abbreviation, or its reuse. Score only a separately attempted referential relation if its target is unclear or conflated.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report introduces or reuses a short form or abbreviation as a naming choice, without an independently assessable reference-resolution problem.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not scored.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not scored: abbreviation formation or expansion alone is not an eligible transformation.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a short form, a particular abbreviation, or its reuse. Score only a separately attempted referential relation if its target is unclear or conflated.

skills.name: Establish and resolve a short-form reference
skills.action: Pair a referent with a supported short form, then use the short form for a later reference when its antecedent is clear.

applicability.description: A report introduces a full name or term, establishes its short form, and later uses that form for the same referent.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a short form where none is chosen; accept coherent alternatives. Assess the expressed reference chain, not hidden input values or a prescribed alias.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively attempts both to establish a short form for a named referent and to use that form later for the referent.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report establishes the full-name/short-form link and later use clearly resolves to that same referent.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted later short-form reference is absent from the established chain, points to a different referent, or is ambiguous between plausible referents.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a short form where none is chosen; accept coherent alternatives. Assess the expressed reference chain, not hidden input values or a prescribed alias.

skills.name: Link a short form to its referent
skills.action: When using a short form, explicitly link it to the corresponding named referent.

applicability.description: A report explicitly pairs a named entity, term, or instrument with a short form, without necessarily reusing it in the observed passage.

context.scope_limits: No particular acronym, parenthetical format, or short form is required. Expansion without an attempted short-form link is outside this operation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively attempts to link a full name or term to a short form, for example by presenting the short form parenthetically or otherwise explicitly identifying it as an equivalent reference.
evaluation.pass_definition: The full name or term and its short form are explicitly linked to the same referent.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the pairing but leaves unclear which name or term the short form denotes, or expressly associates it with a different referent.

extensions.scope_limits: No particular acronym, parenthetical format, or short form is required. Expansion without an attempted short-form link is outside this operation.

skills.name: Define a collective party reference
skills.action: When creating a collective short reference, make its membership clear from the surrounding text.

applicability.description: A report names multiple parties together and elects to establish a collective short reference.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a collective label or any specific label; assess only an attempted group reference.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively attempts to define one collective label or reference for multiple identified parties.
evaluation.pass_definition: The collective reference clearly denotes the parties the report groups together.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted collective label has unclear membership or is expressed as referring to a different or indeterminate set of parties.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a collective label or any specific label; assess only an attempted group reference.

skills.name: Expansion or lexicalization without a reference relation
skills.action: Preserve these observations as provenance for code or acronym expansion, without creating a writing rule.

applicability.description: A report expands a code, acronym, agency name, statute name, or descriptor without establishing a short-form reference relation.

context.scope_limits: Simple entity naming, code expansion, and descriptor expansion alone are ineligible; do not infer a requirement to expand any term.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts only to spell out or render an abbreviated value as a full name or descriptor; merely mentioning a code or its expansion counts.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: expansion or lexicalization alone has no eligible report-observable pass/fail boundary under this bank.

extensions.scope_limits: Simple entity naming, code expansion, and descriptor expansion alone are ineligible; do not infer a requirement to expand any term.

skills.name: Short-form choice without reference formation
skills.action: Retain the observation as provenance for a short-form or descriptor choice, not as a checklist rule.

applicability.description: A report uses a short name, acronym, or compressed label, but the observation does not attempt to establish its relation to an antecedent.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a particular naming choice or treat a different clear description as failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts only to use or prefer a short label, acronym, or concise descriptor, without explicitly linking it to a named referent.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: short-form selection or use alone does not supply an eligible transformation boundary here.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a particular naming choice or treat a different clear description as failure.

skills.name: Other naming or detail-selection observations
skills.action: Preserve these observations as provenance without turning a local naming or detail-selection preference into a rule.

applicability.description: The observation concerns a shortened product or instrument name, an association across different entities, or another naming choice not reducible to a clear short-form link.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer identity across related entities, require omitted name elements, or grade optional naming choices.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts the observed naming, shortening, or association choice without expressing a simple same-referent short-form relation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: the observation does not support a reusable, independently assessable transformation boundary for this parent function.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer identity across related entities, require omitted name elements, or grade optional naming choices.

skills.name: Integrate an organization name split across text units
skills.action: Join adjacent fragments of an organization name into one participant reference.

applicability.description: A participant's organization name is divided across adjacent report units.

context.scope_limits: Assess only whether the report integrates the fragments. Do not require any particular name format or additional participant details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to use a name fragment and its adjacent continuation as one organization reference.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report presents the adjacent fragments as one coherent organization name and reference.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted reference leaves the fragments unattached, makes them appear to identify separate participants, or otherwise leaves unclear whether they form one name.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only whether the report integrates the fragments. Do not require any particular name format or additional participant details.

skills.name: Relate a formal entity name to its operating name
skills.action: When using both supplied forms, state the relationship between an entity's formal name and its operating name.

applicability.description: The record supplies a formal corporate name and a related doing-business-as or operating name.

context.scope_limits: Do not require both name forms to be included; omission is not a failure. Do not treat a facility name as interchangeable with a legal name unless the report expresses that relationship.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to identify an entity using both its formal name and an operating name.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear which name identifies the formal entity and which is its doing-business-as or operating name.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted use of both names leaves their formal-name/operating-name relationship unclear or presents the names as unrelated.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require both name forms to be included; omission is not a failure. Do not treat a facility name as interchangeable with a legal name unless the report expresses that relationship.

skills.name: Clarify the relationship between defendant and facility names
skills.action: When reconciling defendant and facility name forms, express the relationship the report intends between those references.

applicability.description: The report uses variant defendant and facility names and attempts to reconcile them.

context.scope_limits: Assess the relationship as expressed in the report; do not infer identity from similar names or enforce unexpressed source facts.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses both defendant and facility name forms and attempts to identify their relationship.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes its intended relationship between the defendant and facility references clear, distinguishing them when it presents them as distinct.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted reconciliation leaves unclear whether the names refer to the same or related participant, or presents them as interchangeable without expressing the relationship.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess the relationship as expressed in the report; do not infer identity from similar names or enforce unexpressed source facts.

skills.name: Distinguish a product referent from a party in a combined name
skills.action: When using a product component from a combined case name, identify it as the product rather than the party.

applicability.description: A combined case or conclusion name contains both a party name and a product name, and the report uses the product as a referent.

context.scope_limits: Assess only the role distinction expressed in the report. Do not infer a transaction, shipment, or legal status from the name.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to identify a component of a combined case name as the product or item involved.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report's wording makes clear which referent is the product or item and which is the party, without conflating their roles.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted product reference leaves unclear whether the named referent is the product or the party, or expressly assigns the product role to the party name.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only the role distinction expressed in the report. Do not infer a transaction, shipment, or legal status from the name.

skills.name: Simple entity-name rendering or selection
skills.action: Render or select a supplied entity name or concise name form.

applicability.description: The report names an entity, product, facility, or case-associated referent without attempting a more specific relationship operation.

context.scope_limits: Includes product and case-name selection, facility-name phrasing, later entity references, concise name forms, and pairing a facility name with a program designation. These are retained as provenance but are not independently assessable transformations.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to render or select a name for an entity or referent.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: simple entity naming, name selection, or adding a generic noun or program designation has no eligible transformation boundary here.

extensions.scope_limits: Includes product and case-name selection, facility-name phrasing, later entity references, concise name forms, and pairing a facility name with a program designation. These are retained as provenance but are not independently assessable transformations.

skills.name: Person-name rendering
skills.action: Render a supplied person's name with any supplied title or credential.

applicability.description: The report identifies a person using a supplied name and any stated title or credential.

context.scope_limits: Retained as provenance; no particular punctuation, credential format, or inclusion of optional details is required.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to identify a person by name, with or without a title or credential.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: continuous rendering of a person's name and supplied title or credential is simple identification.

extensions.scope_limits: Retained as provenance; no particular punctuation, credential format, or inclusion of optional details is required.

skills.name: Code-to-prose naming
skills.action: Render available codes or structured identifiers as readable names and references.

applicability.description: The report renders enforcement-action information provided as database codes or structured identifiers.

context.scope_limits: Retained as provenance; does not require every available identifier to appear or prescribe a naming convention.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to replace action-type, party, or docket codes with readable names or references.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: code expansion or readable naming alone is not an eligible transformation.

extensions.scope_limits: Retained as provenance; does not require every available identifier to appear or prescribe a naming convention.

skills.name: Enforcement-label lexicalization
skills.action: Render an input-supported enforcement type or instrument as a concise readable label, without treating a label choice as a required fact.

applicability.description: The observation concerns rendering a recorded enforcement type, instrument, mechanism, or action label in prose.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer issuance, issuer, procedural stage, legal effect, or other terms merely from the chosen label. Simple naming and descriptor-to-phrase conversion are ineligible.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively names or describes an enforcement type, instrument, or action from its recorded classification.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable as an assessment rule; the observation records a wording choice rather than an independently assessable relation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not scored: choosing a different coherent label, omitting optional qualifiers, or not naming this optional item has no report-observable failure boundary established by these observations.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer issuance, issuer, procedural stage, legal effect, or other terms merely from the chosen label. Simple naming and descriptor-to-phrase conversion are ineligible.

skills.name: Abbreviation and short-reference wording
skills.action: When useful, state an instrument name and introduce or reuse a concise short form, parameterized to the chosen supported name.

applicability.description: The observation concerns an abbreviation, acronym, or short form for an enforcement type or instrument.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a particular acronym, expansion, heading format, or later reuse; acronym expansion alone is ineligible.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively introduces or uses a short form for a named enforcement type or instrument.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable as an assessment rule; the source records optional abbreviation and reference choices.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not scored: abbreviation choice, expansion, placement, and omission are formatting or naming choices with no required report-observable boundary established here.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a particular acronym, expansion, heading format, or later reuse; acronym expansion alone is ineligible.

skills.name: Express issuance as an event
skills.action: State that the identified instrument was issued when the report elects to express an issuance event.

applicability.description: The report positively states that a described enforcement instrument or order was issued.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer an issuance date, recipient, issuer, finality, or a separate final-order milestone. Naming an order alone is not an attempted issuance relation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses wording that asserts an issuance event for a named or otherwise identified enforcement instrument; merely naming the instrument or its type is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly presents issuance as an event involving the identified instrument, without requiring an unstated date or other optional detail.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to state issuance but leaves the instrument-event relation incomplete or expresses a different procedural event as issuance.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer an issuance date, recipient, issuer, finality, or a separate final-order milestone. Naming an order alone is not an attempted issuance relation.

skills.name: Assign the agency its action role
skills.action: When stating an agency action, connect the agency to the action verb and its instrument or object.

applicability.description: The report positively assigns an agency as the actor issuing or taking the identified enforcement action.

context.scope_limits: Assess only the relation expressed in the report; do not require an agency or action to be mentioned, or infer an issuer from an instrument label.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The wording attempts to connect a named agency to an issuance or enforcement-action verb and an identified instrument or action; merely naming the agency and instrument is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The sentence clearly presents the agency as the actor carrying out or issuing the identified action or instrument.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the agency-action relation but leaves the actor, action, or affected instrument unclear, or grammatically assigns the action to a different participant.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only the relation expressed in the report; do not require an agency or action to be mentioned, or infer an issuer from an instrument label.

skills.name: Keep action type distinct from procedural status
skills.action: When reporting both an enforcement type and a procedural state, express each in its proper role.

applicability.description: The report attempts to state both an enforcement instrument/type and its procedural status, milestone, or finality.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a status or milestone to be mentioned. Do not infer status from a type descriptor or impose a particular tense or phrase.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively expresses an instrument or action type together with a procedural-state or milestone claim; a type label alone is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording makes the instrument/action type and the attempted procedural status or milestone separately intelligible, without making one stand in for the other.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts both elements but conflates them—for example, treating a type label as proof of a procedural stage, or expressing a proposed, issued, or final status ambiguously.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a status or milestone to be mentioned. Do not infer status from a type descriptor or impose a particular tense or phrase.

skills.name: Link an order to its outcomes
skills.action: When reporting an order and its outcomes, explicitly connect the outcomes to that order.

applicability.description: The report states an outcome as applying to, arising under, or being governed by an identified formal order.

context.scope_limits: Assess only an attempted relationship; do not require optional outcomes or infer an order-outcome relationship from adjacent mentions.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively links an outcome to a particular order; merely naming an order and an outcome in separate, unconnected statements is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly identifies the order as the instrument to which the stated outcome applies.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the order-outcome link but leaves unclear which order the outcome belongs to or whether the order governs that outcome.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only an attempted relationship; do not require optional outcomes or infer an order-outcome relationship from adjacent mentions.

skills.name: Realize order issuance as an event
skills.action: Render an order-issuance milestone as a completed issuance event, parameterizing the supported order type.

applicability.description: When the report turns a recorded order-issuance status or milestone into a statement about an order event.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a particular order label, date, acronym expansion, or inclusion of other order details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that an order was issued; merely naming an order or describing an unspecified status is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly states that the supported order type was issued, without adding an unsupported date or procedural detail.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report asserts issuance but leaves it unclear whether issuance occurred, or identifies a different procedural event as the issuance.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a particular order label, date, acronym expansion, or inclusion of other order details.

skills.name: Express achieved compliance status
skills.action: Turn a recorded compliance-achievement milestone into a concise achieved-status proposition.

applicability.description: When a recorded compliance-achievement milestone is rendered as a status proposition.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a date, actor, submission, recipient, or other fact not expressed in the report.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly says that compliance was achieved, correction occurred, or an equivalent compliance status was reached.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly presents the supported compliance milestone as achieved, without extending it to broader compliance claims.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to state an achieved compliance status but instead describes only a requirement, possibility, or incomplete action as achieved.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a date, actor, submission, recipient, or other fact not expressed in the report.

skills.name: Attach a date to its named event
skills.action: Associate a stated date with the specific event it dates, using any clear sentence or entry order.

applicability.description: When a report dates a named conclusion, site action, or procedural milestone.

context.scope_limits: Date-first formatting, a specific date format, and optional site or unit details are not required.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report gives a date and wording that positively associates it with a particular event or determination.
evaluation.pass_definition: The date unambiguously modifies the corresponding event or determination; the event's role is not conflated with another date-bearing milestone.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the association but leaves unclear which event the date belongs to, or attaches it to a different procedural role—for example, using a settlement date as a final-order date.

extensions.scope_limits: Date-first formatting, a specific date format, and optional site or unit details are not required.

skills.name: Keep final-order and instrument identities distinct
skills.action: Preserve the distinction between a final-order milestone and a separately identified agreement or instrument.

applicability.description: When a report identifies both a final-order event and a consent agreement or related instrument.

context.scope_limits: Does not require mentioning an agreement, consent instrument, or separate procedural stage when the report does not choose to discuss it.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively identifies or equates a consent agreement and a final-order milestone as part of describing the same procedural event.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report identifies only the instrument and procedural event it actually names, and does not treat a final-order milestone alone as establishing a consent agreement or two separate dates.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts that identification but presents a final-order milestone as proof of a consent agreement, or asserts separately dated events without expressing that distinction.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require mentioning an agreement, consent instrument, or separate procedural stage when the report does not choose to discuss it.

skills.name: Distinguish settlement from formal-entry milestones
skills.action: Name a settlement as a resolution and preserve the distinct identity of any formal-entry milestone also reported.

applicability.description: When a report discusses both a settlement and a later lodging, entry, or final-order milestone.

context.scope_limits: Does not require including every procedural milestone or assigning dates where none are stated.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively relates a settlement or resolution to a separately mentioned lodging, entry, or final-order milestone.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report keeps the settlement or resolution distinct from any separately mentioned lodging, entry, or final-order status.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to describe both stages but treats the settlement itself as the later formal milestone, or otherwise makes their procedural roles indistinguishable.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require including every procedural milestone or assigning dates where none are stated.

skills.name: Relate a filing to the action's procedural span
skills.action: Connect a filing to the procedural point it marks in the corresponding administrative action.

applicability.description: When a report relates a filing to the beginning or conclusion of an administrative action.

context.scope_limits: A legal basis may be included when stated, but its inclusion is not required by this relation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly characterizes a filing as beginning, concluding, or marking a boundary of an administrative action.
evaluation.pass_definition: The filing's stated role as a beginning, conclusion, or other supported boundary of the action is clear.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report makes that connection but leaves unclear which procedural boundary the filing marks, or claims both boundaries when its wording supports only one.

extensions.scope_limits: A legal basis may be included when stated, but its inclusion is not required by this relation.

skills.name: Separate inspection context from allegations
skills.action: Identify the relevant inspection or review as context for allegations while retaining their allegation status.

applicability.description: When allegations are presented in relation to an inspection or review that provides their context.

context.scope_limits: Does not require inspection details or findings that the report does not state.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively frames an inspection or review as the basis or context for allegations.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes the inspection's contextual or evidentiary relationship to the allegations clear without recasting allegations as established findings.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts that connection but makes the allegations appear to be inspection findings, or leaves the inspection's relationship to them unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require inspection details or findings that the report does not state.

skills.name: Attribute a finding to an inspection
skills.action: State the inspection or review as the event that uncovered the reported finding.

applicability.description: When a report states that an inspection or review uncovered a finding.

context.scope_limits: Does not require describing inspection methods or enumerating violations.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively attributes a finding to an inspection or review.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly relates the finding to the inspection or review that uncovered it.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the attribution but leaves unclear whether the inspection uncovered the finding, or attributes the finding to a different event.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require describing inspection methods or enumerating violations.

skills.name: Keep complaint allegations distinct from findings
skills.action: Relate a complaint milestone to the conduct alleged without presenting the allegation as an established finding.

applicability.description: When a report connects a complaint milestone to conduct alleged in the complaint.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a filing-versus-issuance distinction or a milestone date unless the report states one.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively relates the complaint's filing or issuance to conduct described as alleged.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report identifies the complaint as a procedural event and retains the alleged status of the conduct it concerns.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the connection but presents the alleged conduct as a finding, or makes the complaint and conduct relationship unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a filing-versus-issuance distinction or a milestone date unless the report states one.

skills.name: Distinguish directed import action from completed outcome
skills.action: Express an import-control action with its supported modality and distinguish an instruction from a completed result.

applicability.description: When an import-control action is described as requested, directed, or completed.

context.scope_limits: Does not require any particular enforcement phrase, destination, or endpoint.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively describes an import-related action and indicates whether it was requested, directed, or completed.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording preserves whether the action was requested or directed versus actually completed, and states an endpoint only when the report presents it as an outcome.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to state the action's status but converts a request or direction into a completed outcome, or leaves that distinction unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require any particular enforcement phrase, destination, or endpoint.

skills.name: Connect inspection purpose to its regulatory basis
skills.action: Describe an inspection's assessment purpose and attach the supported regulatory program or legal basis to it.

applicability.description: When an inspection is described in terms of what compliance it assessed and the relevant program or statutory authority.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer an exact regulatory citation solely from a broad program or statute description.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively links an inspection's assessment purpose to a regulatory program or legal basis.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear what compliance the inspection assessed and relates the stated program or authority to that review.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the link but leaves unclear what compliance was under review or attaches the program or authority to an unrelated action.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer an exact regulatory citation solely from a broad program or statute description.

skills.name: Mark and locate a later inspection
skills.action: When a later inspection is reported, mark its temporal relation and connect its stated location or authority to the inspection.

applicability.description: When a report includes a later inspection as a transition from earlier conduct or activity, particularly at another case location.

context.scope_limits: This rule does not require inventing an inspection, date, or inspecting authority not otherwise reported.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively presents an inspection as later than an earlier event or conduct and relates it to a facility, location, or inspecting authority.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly signals that the inspection is later than the earlier event and makes any stated location or authority attach to that inspection.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the transition but makes the temporal order or the inspection's location or attribution ambiguous.

extensions.scope_limits: This rule does not require inventing an inspection, date, or inspecting authority not otherwise reported.

skills.name: Link a submission to its stated compliance outcome
skills.action: Relate a reported submission to the compliance outcome expressly associated with it.

applicability.description: When a report relates a submission to a compliance outcome.

context.scope_limits: Neither a submission nor an outcome must be mentioned if the report does not choose to include it.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively connects a submission with a stated compliance outcome.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes the relationship between the submission and the associated compliance outcome clear without adding unsupported submission details.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the connection but leaves unclear whether the outcome followed from, or was associated with, the submission.

extensions.scope_limits: Neither a submission nor an outcome must be mentioned if the report does not choose to include it.

skills.name: State a resolved-matter status
skills.action: Express a recorded completed or closed enforcement outcome as resolution of the matter.

applicability.description: When a report states that an enforcement matter reached resolution based on a completed or closed outcome.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a resolution date, penalty amount, or procedural details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly describes the matter as resolved, settled, or closed.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly describes the matter as resolved in accordance with the completed or closed outcome it states.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report asserts resolution but its wording instead describes only an unresolved or pending action as completed.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a resolution date, penalty amount, or procedural details.

skills.name: Simple activity-type lexicalization
skills.action: Render an activity-type descriptor as a familiar event noun.

applicability.description: When a report renders an activity category as an event noun, such as describing an activity-type label as an inspection.

context.scope_limits: Adding a program qualifier or choosing a shorter activity label is optional and does not create a separate rule.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses a plain-language event noun for an activity category.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: naming the activity in ordinary event language alone does not define an eligible transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: this is simple activity naming, without a separately assessable relationship, qualification, or state distinction.

extensions.scope_limits: Adding a program qualifier or choosing a shorter activity label is optional and does not create a separate rule.

skills.name: Simple combination of case and event descriptors
skills.action: Combine supported case and event descriptors in a compact phrase.

applicability.description: When a report combines an administrative descriptor with a complaint milestone label.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a particular compound wording or descriptor selection.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report combines an administrative-case characterization and a complaint-event label.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: selecting a compound descriptor alone is not an assessable transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: the observation concerns descriptor combination without a distinct relation or state boundary.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a particular compound wording or descriptor selection.

skills.name: Optional aggregation of procedural and outcome details
skills.action: Optionally summarize selected related milestones or outcome details together.

applicability.description: When a report selects and combines optional details from multiple milestones or outcomes.

context.scope_limits: A coherent alternative selection or omission is acceptable; a multi-item list rule cannot be inferred from optional aggregation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report combines two or more independently expressible milestone, conclusion, action-type, or outcome details.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: no single required combination or coverage threshold is established.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: inclusion or omission of optional details and their aggregation do not establish a distinct required relationship.

extensions.scope_limits: A coherent alternative selection or omission is acceptable; a multi-item list rule cannot be inferred from optional aggregation.

skills.name: Simple event-code or label reference
skills.action: Refer to a case event by a code or established label.

applicability.description: When a report refers to an event through a code or established label.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer that a named final-order event resolves particular violations unless the report expressly makes that relation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses an event code or label as a reference to a case event.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: using a code or established label alone is not an eligible transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: the observation supports event naming, but does not establish a distinct reference ambiguity that this rule can assess.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer that a named final-order event resolves particular violations unless the report expressly makes that relation.

skills.name: Optional title-detail selection
skills.action: Form a compact entry title from selected site, unit, or descriptive components.

applicability.description: When a report forms a compact title by selecting site, unit, or descriptive details from an input name.

context.scope_limits: Uncertain characters in an input name do not support a rule about their intended meaning.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report creates a short entry title from selected components of a longer name.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: no particular selected detail, title length, or line layout is required.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: optional selection of identifying details and title format do not establish a required logical relation.

extensions.scope_limits: Uncertain characters in an input name do not support a rule about their intended meaning.

skills.name: Simple import-action lexicalization
skills.action: Describe an import-related action using supported plain-language wording.

applicability.description: When a report states an import-related action using a chosen enforcement phrase or endpoint.

context.scope_limits: Do not generalize a specific enforcement phrase or endpoint to other reports.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report names an import-related enforcement action or destination.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: no exact action phrase or destination is required by this observation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: action naming or phrase choice alone does not establish a modality or outcome distinction.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not generalize a specific enforcement phrase or endpoint to other reports.

skills.name: Map an action to its recipient
skills.action: State who receives or is directed to act under the reported enforcement event; parameterize the participant and event.

applicability.description: When a report positively states that a named party receives, is issued, or is directed an enforcement action, instrument, or required submission.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer receipt from defendant, facility, complaint, or settlement status alone. This is not the issuing-authority or agency-as-actor relation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly attempts to identify a participant as the recipient or target of a stated action, instrument, notice, order, or submission.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly links the stated action or instrument to the participant it identifies as recipient or target, without implying unsupported additional roles.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts this relation but assigns the recipient/target role to the wrong participant, or its wording leaves the recipient of that event unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer receipt from defendant, facility, complaint, or settlement status alone. This is not the issuing-authority or agency-as-actor relation.

skills.name: Assign an enforcement action to its actor
skills.action: Express the supported authority as the performer of the reported action, keeping any regulated party in its distinct role.

applicability.description: When the report describes an enforcement or agreement action and identifies the agency or office performing it.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer an agency's action from its mere presence in case fields. Issuing an instrument is a separate role when specifically expressed.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that an agency, office, or region performed or took the described action.
evaluation.pass_definition: The stated agency or office is clearly the actor of the action, and the report does not confuse that role with the party acted upon.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to identify the acting authority but assigns the action to the wrong participant, or conflates the authority with the regulated party or recipient.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer an agency's action from its mere presence in case fields. Issuing an instrument is a separate role when specifically expressed.

skills.name: Identify the payer
skills.action: State which participant pays or owes the specified payment.

applicability.description: When a report explicitly identifies a party as the payer of a stated penalty or payment.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer payer status from defendant status, settlement participation, or the identity of the payment recipient.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively links a named participant to paying or owing a stated payment.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly distinguishes the party paying or owing the payment from its recipient and other case participants.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to identify the payer but assigns the payment obligation to the wrong participant or leaves the payer unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer payer status from defendant status, settlement participation, or the identity of the payment recipient.

skills.name: Identify the payment recipient
skills.action: Name the supported recipient of a reported payment.

applicability.description: When a report identifies an agency or other participant as the destination of a stated payment.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer payment routing from an agency lead or regional-office field alone.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states who receives a specified payment.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the participant receiving the payment and keeps that role distinct from who pays it.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to identify the payment recipient but assigns that role to the payer or another participant, or makes the destination ambiguous.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer payment routing from an agency lead or regional-office field alone.

skills.name: Attribute an allegation without turning it into a finding
skills.action: Attribute the alleged conduct to the supported party and retain the report's allegation-versus-finding distinction.

applicability.description: When the report positively characterizes conduct or a violation as alleged, or identifies the party against whom a complaint or allegation is made.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer the truth or details of alleged conduct from party identity or complaint flags. A concluded or adjudicated violation belongs to a distinct outcome relation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly attributes alleged conduct, a violation allegation, or a complaint to or against a named participant.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies whose conduct is alleged and preserves its allegation status rather than presenting it as an adjudicated finding.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts that attribution but links it to the wrong party, leaves the attributed party unclear, or states an allegation as an established finding without marking that change in status.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer the truth or details of alleged conduct from party identity or complaint flags. A concluded or adjudicated violation belongs to a distinct outcome relation.

skills.name: Link resolved violations to the correct parties
skills.action: Connect a reported resolution to the party or parties whose violations it resolves.

applicability.description: When a report states that a resolution addresses, resolves, or otherwise disposes of violations attributed to one or more parties.

context.scope_limits: Do not add underlying allegations, findings, or factual details not stated in the report.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively links a resolution to violations attributed to identified participants.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies whose violations the resolution addresses, preserving any distinct party identities stated in the report.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts this relation but attaches the resolved violations to the wrong participant, leaves the attribution unclear, or treats the resolution relation as proof of unreported factual details.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not add underlying allegations, findings, or factual details not stated in the report.

skills.name: Assign a proceeding-specific party role
skills.action: Identify the participant in the procedural role supported by the report context.

applicability.description: When the report positively describes a party as a defendant, respondent, or other proceeding-specific procedural participant.

context.scope_limits: Do not assume every defendant is a respondent or treat a role label as evidence of alleged conduct or its truth.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses a procedural role to identify a participant in a proceeding or expressly states the proceeding is against that participant.
evaluation.pass_definition: The role label clearly belongs to the identified participant and is appropriate to the proceeding as described; it is not confused with recipient, payer, or agency roles.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the procedural-role relation but applies the role to the wrong participant, uses a role inconsistent with the described proceeding, or leaves which participant holds that role ambiguous.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not assume every defendant is a respondent or treat a role label as evidence of alleged conduct or its truth.

skills.name: Identify parties to an agreement or settlement
skills.action: State which supported participants are parties to the specified agreement or settlement.

applicability.description: When the report identifies multiple participants as parties to a settlement, agreement, or formal enforcement document.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer that all defendants, facilities, or agencies are parties merely because they appear in case data.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that a named party or parties entered into, joined, or are parties to a settlement, agreement, or enforcement document.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly links the named participants to the stated agreement, settlement, or document and does not imply unsupported participation by others.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the agreement/settlement relation but assigns participation to the wrong party, or leaves unclear which named parties are included.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer that all defendants, facilities, or agencies are parties merely because they appear in case data.

skills.name: Maintain a clear collective party reference
skills.action: Introduce the parties included in a group and use a collective reference only while that group remains the referent.

applicability.description: When multiple parties are introduced and the report uses a collective role or later collective reference for that same set.

context.scope_limits: A list with only one participant does not create this operation. Do not infer equal responsibility or identical roles from collective wording.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively groups two or more participants under a shared label or refers back to them collectively.
evaluation.pass_definition: The collective label clearly refers to the same stated group of parties throughout the relevant passage.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts a collective reference but the label's membership is unclear, changes without indication, or wrongly includes or excludes a participant.

extensions.scope_limits: A list with only one participant does not create this operation. Do not infer equal responsibility or identical roles from collective wording.

skills.name: Keep a role-based reference tied to its participant
skills.action: Establish a supported party-role reference and reuse it only while its referent remains unambiguous.

applicability.description: When a report introduces a party by name or role and later refers to that same party through a role-based label across nearby text.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a shortened or role-based reference where none is used. A role label is unsafe when multiple participants could be its referent.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report establishes a role-based reference and uses it again for the same participant in a later clause or sentence.
evaluation.pass_definition: The role-based reference remains clearly and consistently linked to the participant first introduced.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the reference chain but the later label could refer to another participant, changes referent, or conflicts with the role established earlier.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a shortened or role-based reference where none is used. A role label is unsafe when multiple participants could be its referent.

skills.name: Ineligible: participant naming or underspecified role
skills.action: Preserve the provenance as participant-identification observations without turning name selection into a checklist requirement.

applicability.description: Observations that only name or identify a participant, give a generic role without a distinct event relation, or express a witness's optional selection of which party to mention.

context.scope_limits: Does not cover explicit recipient, actor, allegation, procedural-role, payment, agreement, or reference-chain relations, which have separate groups.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: this group records observations that do not specify a separately assessable relational operation.
evaluation.pass_definition: No pass criterion is defined because simple naming or underspecified identification has no concrete relational boundary here.
evaluation.fail_definition: No report-level failure is defined for these observations; omission of an optional name or focus is not a failure.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not cover explicit recipient, actor, allegation, procedural-role, payment, agreement, or reference-chain relations, which have separate groups.

skills.name: Ineligible: presentation preference
skills.action: Retain these observations as provenance without requiring passive voice, an opening position, or a particular layout.

applicability.description: Observations about passive voice, opening position, standalone naming lines, name rendering, or other presentation choices without a distinct logical relation.

context.scope_limits: Does not subsume cases where ordering is necessary to distinguish a specific temporal, attribution, or role relation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: these observations record optional form or layout rather than an assessable relational transformation.
evaluation.pass_definition: No pass criterion is defined for these optional presentation choices.
evaluation.fail_definition: No report-level failure is defined; alternative coherent wording, voice, or layout is not a failure.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not subsume cases where ordering is necessary to distinguish a specific temporal, attribution, or role relation.

skills.name: Distinguish an instrument's issuer from its recipient
skills.action: State who issued the instrument, separately from who received or was directed by it.

applicability.description: When the report expressly says a named authority issued a specified enforcement instrument.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer the issuing authority from a lead-agency field unless the report states that it issued the instrument.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively identifies an authority as issuer of an enforcement instrument.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the supported issuer and keeps that role distinct from the entity to whom the instrument is issued.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to identify the issuer but assigns issuance to the wrong participant or confuses the issuer with the instrument's recipient.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer the issuing authority from a lead-agency field unless the report states that it issued the instrument.

skills.name: Attribute an enforcement action to its actor
skills.action: Express the supported agency or region as the actor performing the reported enforcement action.

applicability.description: A report expressly attributes an enforcement action to an agency, region, or authority.

context.scope_limits: Does not require naming an agency or region, establish an unexpressed action, or require a particular code expansion. Formal instrument issuance is covered separately.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states that an identified agency or region performed or took an enforcement action; merely naming it is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear which agency or region performed the stated enforcement action.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted clause leaves the actor unclear, assigns the action to a different participant within the report, or conflates the agency/region with another role.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require naming an agency or region, establish an unexpressed action, or require a particular code expansion. Formal instrument issuance is covered separately.

skills.name: Assign roles in a formal-instrument event
skills.action: State who issued or filed the identified instrument and, when expressed, who received or was subject to it.

applicability.description: A report describes a formal order, notice, or other instrument and expresses who issued it; recipient roles apply when the report also expresses a recipient.

context.scope_limits: Does not require including an optional recipient, legal basis, date, or instrument detail. Do not infer issuance solely from an agency field.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that an authority issued, filed, or sent a specified formal instrument, or identifies the issuer and recipient in that instrument event.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report distinguishes the issuing authority, the instrument or action, and any stated recipient in the roles it expresses.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted proposition makes the instrument’s issuer or recipient unclear, reverses their expressed roles, or conflates the issuing authority with the instrument or recipient.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require including an optional recipient, legal basis, date, or instrument detail. Do not infer issuance solely from an agency field.

skills.name: Attribute an inspection or evaluation to its actor
skills.action: State which agency performed the reported inspection, evaluation, or related activity.

applicability.description: A report attributes an inspection, evaluation, or inspection-related activity to an agency and may identify the facility or subject.

context.scope_limits: Does not require inspection findings, procedures, or an inspection statement when that activity is not selected.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states that an agency conducted, performed, or carried out an inspection, evaluation, or related activity.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report identifies the agency as performer and keeps any stated facility or subject in its distinct role.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted account leaves unclear which agency performed the activity or, when a subject is expressly included, confuses the actor with the inspected subject.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require inspection findings, procedures, or an inspection statement when that activity is not selected.

skills.name: Attribute an allegation without converting it to a finding
skills.action: Attribute the reported allegation to the agency making it, preserving its status as an allegation.

applicability.description: A report states that an agency made or advanced an allegation.

context.scope_limits: Does not establish that the agency actually alleged something based on a lead-agency field alone, or require mentioning an allegation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively attributes an allegation of a violation or other claim to an identified agency.
evaluation.pass_definition: The agency is identifiable as the source of the allegation and the claim remains an allegation.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted statement leaves unclear who made the allegation or presents the allegation as an established finding rather than an attributed claim.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not establish that the agency actually alleged something based on a lead-agency field alone, or require mentioning an allegation.

skills.name: Attribute a determination and identify its subject
skills.action: Attribute the determination to the responsible agency and identify the party it concerns.

applicability.description: A report attributes a determination to an agency and identifies the party to which it applies.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a determination or party reference when omitted, and does not convert an allegation into a finding.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states that an identified agency made a determination concerning an identified party.
evaluation.pass_definition: The agency is the clear maker of the determination and the named party is clearly the party it concerns.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted statement obscures who made the determination or who it concerns, or conflates the determination with an allegation.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a determination or party reference when omitted, and does not convert an allegation into a finding.

skills.name: Separate investigator from investigative subject
skills.action: Identify the agency as the actor in the investigative action and the relevant entity as its subject.

applicability.description: A report attributes an investigative or evidence-gathering action to an agency and may name its subject.

context.scope_limits: Does not imply investigative facts beyond those stated or require naming a subject if none is expressed.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states that an agency investigated, gathered evidence, or performed a comparable investigative action concerning an entity.
evaluation.pass_definition: The agency is identifiable as the investigative actor and the named entity as the subject, where the report expresses both.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted account confuses the investigating agency with the subject of the investigation or leaves either role unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not imply investigative facts beyond those stated or require naming a subject if none is expressed.

skills.name: Attribute a program-implementation role
skills.action: Link the identified agency to the implementation role stated in the report.

applicability.description: A report describes an agency’s role in implementing a program.

context.scope_limits: Does not establish an ongoing or broader program role beyond the report’s expressed scope.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states that an agency implemented a program or performed a specified implementation role.
evaluation.pass_definition: The agency is clearly linked to the stated implementation role and its expressed scope.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted clause leaves unclear whether the agency or another participant has the implementation role, or makes the role broader than the report’s expressed scope.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not establish an ongoing or broader program role beyond the report’s expressed scope.

skills.name: Assign the notifying-party role
skills.action: Name the supported agency or organization as the actor or party responsible for the reported notification.

applicability.description: A report describes an agency, region, or organization performing a notification-related action or serving as the notifying party.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a notification or recipient, and does not infer notification activity from agency or region identifiers alone.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states who notified, mailed, or otherwise performed a notification, or identifies an organization in the notifying-party role.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly distinguishes the party performing or responsible for the notification from any recipient.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted wording leaves the notifying actor unclear, confuses the notifying party with the recipient, or treats a merely named agency as the notifier.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a notification or recipient, and does not infer notification activity from agency or region identifiers alone.

skills.name: Link an organization to another stated case action
skills.action: Connect the identified organization to the particular action or event role expressed in the report.

applicability.description: A report attributes a case action or participation to an organization, but the action is not a formal issuance, inspection, allegation, determination, investigation, implementation, or notification covered elsewhere.

context.scope_limits: Does not require an action statement, infer an action from an entity field, or cover the separately grouped role types.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states that an identified organization performed a specific non-specialized case action or participated in a stated event.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly expresses the organization’s stated action or participation without assigning a different role to it.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted statement leaves the organization’s relation to the event unclear or conflates its stated role with another participant’s role or an event status.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require an action statement, infer an action from an entity field, or cover the separately grouped role types.

skills.name: Express parties to an entered instrument
skills.action: State that the agency entered into the identified instrument or agreement with the other party.

applicability.description: A report states that an agency entered into an agreement or enforcement instrument with another party.

context.scope_limits: Does not imply that the agency issued the instrument to the other party or add legal effects not stated.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively describes the agency and another party as counterparties entering into the same instrument or agreement.
evaluation.pass_definition: The agency and other party are clearly represented as counterparties to the instrument or agreement.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted sentence makes one party appear to issue the instrument to the other, or otherwise obscures their stated counterparty relationship.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not imply that the agency issued the instrument to the other party or add legal effects not stated.

skills.name: Entity and identifier rendering only
skills.action: Preserve the observed agency, region, code, or acronym rendering as an ineligible naming-only observation.

applicability.description: The observation concerns only expanding or rendering an agency or region identifier, attaching an agency and region as a label, or forming an agency reference without an assessable event-role relation.

context.scope_limits: A naming operation may accompany an eligible role mapping, but naming alone is not a pass/fail rule. No particular expansion or label format is required.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: entity naming, code rendering, or label formation alone is not an eligible transformation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: this group preserves provenance for observations that do not establish an eligible relation or operation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable. Do not score the presence, spelling, expansion, or format of a name or code as a transformation failure.

extensions.scope_limits: A naming operation may accompany an eligible role mapping, but naming alone is not a pass/fail rule. No particular expansion or label format is required.

skills.name: Opening and framing preference
skills.action: Preserve the observed opening or framing choice without turning it into a rule.

applicability.description: The observation concerns document opening, framing, abbreviation introduction and reuse, or another opening-position preference without a required report-observable relation.

context.scope_limits: Does not prescribe where a report must begin or require an abbreviation when a coherent alternative is used.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: an opening or framing preference alone is not an eligible transformation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: this group preserves provenance for an ineligible document-level preference.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable. Do not score opening position, optional acronym introduction, or framing preference as a failure.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not prescribe where a report must begin or require an abbreviation when a coherent alternative is used.

skills.name: Render a region identifier readably
skills.action: Render the supplied region identifier as a readable region label, parameterizing its number and display format.

applicability.description: When a report renders a supplied region code as a reader-facing region label or number.

context.scope_limits: Does not establish geographic coverage, agency responsibility, an actor's role, or a universal number format. Any such claim requires separate support.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to identify a region by converting a supplied region identifier into a readable regional designation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable; this operation is ineligible for the transformation bank.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable as a banked writing transformation: these observations concern code rendering or simple naming alone, without an assessable relation, qualification, state distinction, or nontrivial integration.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not establish geographic coverage, agency responsibility, an actor's role, or a universal number format. Any such claim requires separate support.

skills.name: Distinguish party from facility in location links
skills.action: When linking a party to a facility location, make clear whether the place describes the facility or the party itself.

applicability.description: A report expressly associates a party with a facility location, and the party and facility could be mistaken for the same thing.

context.scope_limits: Only assess an expressed party–facility–location relation. Do not require a location to be mentioned, a particular address detail, or a specific wording or placement.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report links a named party or action recipient to a facility or its location.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording makes the party–facility relation and the location's referent clear, without equating the party with the facility or claiming an unsupported personal or business address.
evaluation.fail_definition: The wording leaves unclear whether the location belongs to the party or its facility, or presents a facility location as the party's residence, headquarters, or address without saying that this is the intended relation.

extensions.scope_limits: Only assess an expressed party–facility–location relation. Do not require a location to be mentioned, a particular address detail, or a specific wording or placement.

skills.name: Relate a reported event to its site
skills.action: When locating a reported event, explicitly connect that event to the site it occurred at.

applicability.description: A report states or attempts to state where alleged conduct, an inspection, a finding, or another case event occurred.

context.scope_limits: Assess only the expressed event–site relation. Do not assess whether the event or allegation is true, and do not require location detail when the report does not attempt this relation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses wording that places a specific action, event, or conduct at a facility or other location.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly identifies the site as the location of the particular event or conduct it describes, and does not conflate the site's association with the case with proof that the event occurred there.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report asserts or implies that the event occurred at a location without expressing the event-to-site relation clearly, or treats a facility association alone as establishing where the event occurred.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only the expressed event–site relation. Do not assess whether the event or allegation is true, and do not require location detail when the report does not attempt this relation.

skills.name: Keep multi-site scope and site-specific claims distinguishable
skills.action: For a multi-site action or allegation, group facilities only under the scope stated and retain distinctions that attach claims to particular sites.
