applicability.description: A report groups locations or facilities under one action, or reports similar allegations associated with more than one site.

context.scope_limits: Assess only the report's expressed facility grouping and claim-to-site mapping. Do not require separate mentions or grouping, and do not infer scope from a facility list alone.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report explicitly groups multiple facilities or locations under a shared action, scope, or allegation.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording makes clear which facilities are grouped under the stated scope and preserves any site-specific distinction needed to understand the action or allegation.
evaluation.fail_definition: The wording obscures which facilities are covered or which site-specific statement applies to which facility, or groups a facility in a way that conflicts with the scope expressed in the report.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only the report's expressed facility grouping and claim-to-site mapping. Do not require separate mentions or grouping, and do not infer scope from a facility list alone.

skills.name: Integrate multiple locations under a shared activity
skills.action: When reporting one activity across multiple locations, make the shared activity and the scope of its date clear.

applicability.description: A report presents one activity at multiple locations together, particularly when it also gives a shared date.

context.scope_limits: Assess only the integration of locations, activity, and any shared date. Do not require multiple locations to be combined or infer a separate event, date, or finding for each site.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report presents multiple locations as part of one activity statement or explicitly gives them a shared date.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording makes clear that the locations belong to the same reported activity and that any shared date modifies that activity, without assigning unexpressed separate dates or findings to individual locations.
evaluation.fail_definition: The wording makes it unclear whether the date applies to the activity or to each location, or implies separate location-specific dates or findings that the statement does not express.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only the integration of locations, activity, and any shared date. Do not require multiple locations to be combined or infer a separate event, date, or finding for each site.

skills.name: Entity naming and simple reference formation
skills.action: Name an entity or introduce a concise reference when useful.

applicability.description: A report simply names a party, facility, site, or entity, or introduces a label or short form.

context.scope_limits: Preserves observations about names, labels, and short forms; does not assess factual identity, spelling, capitalization, or whether a label was necessary.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report names an entity or introduces a label or abbreviated reference.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not scored as an independent transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: entity naming or label choice alone does not provide the required relational pass/fail boundary.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserves observations about names, labels, and short forms; does not assess factual identity, spelling, capitalization, or whether a label was necessary.

skills.name: Location rendering and detail selection
skills.action: Express supported location details as a readable place phrase.

applicability.description: A report renders a location using supplied city, state, address, or other geographic components.

context.scope_limits: Preserves observations about city/state aggregation, address detail selection, and location phrasing. No particular detail, format, or level of precision is mandatory.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expresses a location phrase or selects geographic details for one.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not scored as an independent transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: location formatting, aggregation, or selection alone does not establish a sufficiently distinctive relational transformation.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserves observations about city/state aggregation, address detail selection, and location phrasing. No particular detail, format, or level of precision is mandatory.

skills.name: Geographic code rendering
skills.action: Render a supplied geographic code in readable prose when desired.

applicability.description: A report expands a supplied geographic abbreviation or renders a geographic code as prose.

context.scope_limits: Preserves observations about state-name expansion and similar lexicalization; does not assess whether the code was correctly expanded.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report spells out or otherwise renders a supplied state or location code.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not scored as an independent transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: code expansion alone is not an assessable relational transformation.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserves observations about state-name expansion and similar lexicalization; does not assess whether the code was correctly expanded.

skills.name: Repeated-information compression
skills.action: Compress repeated identity or location references when it preserves the distinctions needed by the report.

applicability.description: A report condenses repeated identity or location material, or chooses where to place optional location context.

context.scope_limits: Preserves observations about repeated-information compression; does not impose a duty to compress or suppress site distinctions.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report compresses repeated references or places optional location information in a selected position.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not scored as an independent transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: compression or placement preference alone does not create a concrete relational pass/fail boundary.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserves observations about repeated-information compression; does not impose a duty to compress or suppress site distinctions.

skills.name: Optional location focus and placement
skills.action: Include and place location context when it serves the account.

applicability.description: A report selects whether or where to include optional location context, including in an opening or follow-on phrase.

context.scope_limits: Preserves observations about opening position, follow-on placement, and selection of optional location material. Omission of an optional fact is not a failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report elects to include location context or gives it a particular position without attempting another assessable relation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not scored as an independent transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: optional coverage and arbitrary placement are not failures.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserves observations about opening position, follow-on placement, and selection of optional location material. Omission of an optional fact is not a failure.

skills.name: Attach a date to its procedural event
skills.action: State a recorded procedural-event date in relation to the specific filing, order, settlement, or other milestone it dates.

applicability.description: Use when a report states a date for a named enforcement or procedural event, such as filing, settlement entry, order issuance, or another recorded milestone.

context.scope_limits: Parameterize the event and date; do not require a particular format, placement, or choice among optional events. Do not conflate final-order dates with closure dates, or filing, issuance, and settlement-entry dates with one another. If the input has matching dates for multiple events, assess only the relation expressed in the report, not which underlying field supplied the value.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states or implies that a particular procedural event occurred on a date. Merely mentioning a date or event separately is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear which procedural event the stated date belongs to. It may use any coherent date expression and need not report every available date or milestone.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to date a procedural event but leaves the date-event relation unclear, attaches the date to a different event in its own wording, or treats distinct procedural milestones as interchangeable. A shared date value alone does not make distinct events the same event.

extensions.scope_limits: Parameterize the event and date; do not require a particular format, placement, or choice among optional events. Do not conflate final-order dates with closure dates, or filing, issuance, and settlement-entry dates with one another. If the input has matching dates for multiple events, assess only the relation expressed in the report, not which underlying field supplied the value.

skills.name: Attach a date to its related activity
skills.action: State the recorded date in relation to the related activity it dates.

applicability.description: Use when a report dates a related activity, such as an inspection or evaluation.

context.scope_limits: Parameterize the activity and date. Do not infer that an activity-status date establishes a separate event date, require a particular date format, or require mention of an activity that the report does not otherwise choose to cover.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively presents a date as belonging to a named or identifiable related activity. A date mention or activity mention alone is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly connects the stated date to the inspection, evaluation, or other related activity it describes.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to date the activity but does not make clear that the date belongs to that activity, or its wording assigns the date to a different event.

extensions.scope_limits: Parameterize the activity and date. Do not infer that an activity-status date establishes a separate event date, require a particular date format, or require mention of an activity that the report does not otherwise choose to cover.

skills.name: Realize final-order status as an issuance event
skills.action: When the report chooses to describe a recorded final-order status as an event, state that the order was issued.

applicability.description: Use when a report expresses a recorded final-order status as an issuance event.

context.scope_limits: This transformation concerns status-to-event wording only. Do not require a date, infer the identity of an official who entered the order, or treat simple naming of a Final Order as evidence of issuance.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively describes the recorded final-order status as an event of issuing or issuance; merely naming a final order is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly expresses the relevant final-order status as an issuance event without confusing it with another milestone.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to express the status as issuance but leaves unclear whether issuance occurred or describes a different state or event.

extensions.scope_limits: This transformation concerns status-to-event wording only. Do not require a date, infer the identity of an official who entered the order, or treat simple naming of a Final Order as evidence of issuance.

skills.name: Optional date-and-action heading
skills.action: Preserve as provenance for an observed heading choice; do not require a heading or a particular opening position.

applicability.description: Applies to the observation that recommends leading with an enforcement-type label and date as a heading.

context.scope_limits: The heading recommendation is an optional format and focus preference. A substantive date-to-event relation, if separately attempted in report prose, is assessed under the applicable date-attachment group.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: this observation concerns an optional heading or opening choice, not a required relational transformation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable; no report-observable pass condition is imposed.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable; absence of the suggested heading or opening is not a failure.

extensions.scope_limits: The heading recommendation is an optional format and focus preference. A substantive date-to-event relation, if separately attempted in report prose, is assessed under the applicable date-attachment group.

skills.name: Final Order descriptor wording
skills.action: Preserve as provenance for a descriptor choice without requiring a particular label.

applicability.description: Applies to an observation that only recommends rendering a final-order milestone as a prose reference to a Final Order.

context.scope_limits: Entity naming or descriptor lexicalization alone is ineligible. A separately attempted date-event relation or status-to-event transformation remains assessable under its own group.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: simply naming or lexicalizing an entity does not attempt a separately assessable relation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable; no report-observable pass condition is imposed.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable; omission or alternative naming is not a failure.

extensions.scope_limits: Entity naming or descriptor lexicalization alone is ineligible. A separately attempted date-event relation or status-to-event transformation remains assessable under its own group.

skills.name: Attribute a date to its event
skills.action: State a reported date in a way that identifies the action or event it dates.

applicability.description: A report explicitly dates an enforcement action, disposition, inspection, or other case event.

context.scope_limits: Does not require an opening date, any particular event to be selected, or a date absent from the report. Do not collapse distinct milestones such as issuance, filing, final order, or closure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states a date as belonging to a specific event or procedural milestone.
evaluation.pass_definition: The date is clearly tied to the stated action or event; no different milestone is implied.
evaluation.fail_definition: A date is given but its event is unclear, or it is grammatically attributed to a different event than the report says it dates.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require an opening date, any particular event to be selected, or a date absent from the report. Do not collapse distinct milestones such as issuance, filing, final order, or closure.

skills.name: Attribute an enforcement action to its issuer
skills.action: Connect the issuing authority to the enforcement action in its issuer or actor role.

applicability.description: A report expressly says an agency or office issued or took a named enforcement action.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer an issuer from a governing law, a regional label, or another participant. This does not require naming an issuer.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states both an authority and an enforcement action and uses wording that assigns the authority the issuer or acting role.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly identifies the stated agency or office as the issuer or actor for that action.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report names an authority and an action but leaves the role unclear, or presents the authority as a different participant, such as the respondent.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer an issuer from a governing law, a regional label, or another participant. This does not require naming an issuer.

skills.name: Connect an action or instrument to its recipient or counterparty
skills.action: State the supported relationship between an enforcement action or instrument and the party receiving or entering it.

applicability.description: A report expressly describes an enforcement instrument or action as issued to, entered with, or made between a responsible party and an authority.

context.scope_limits: A party's mere presence or naming is not an attempt. Do not treat an issuer, respondent, recipient, and instrument counterparty as interchangeable.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses wording that assigns a party the role of recipient or counterparty to a stated action or instrument.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly expresses the supported recipient or counterparty relationship.
evaluation.fail_definition: The party and action or instrument are both mentioned, but the wording leaves their recipient/counterparty relationship unclear or assigns the party a different role.

extensions.scope_limits: A party's mere presence or naming is not an attempt. Do not treat an issuer, respondent, recipient, and instrument counterparty as interchangeable.

skills.name: Preserve allegation status in relation to an action or resolution
skills.action: Connect an enforcement action or resolution to the matter alleged while preserving whether the matter is alleged or established.

applicability.description: A report refers to allegations, a settlement of allegations, or an action addressing an alleged violation.

context.scope_limits: Does not require mention of allegations or findings. Do not infer a finding from the existence of a settlement or action.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively describes an allegation or alleged violation and connects it to a resolution or enforcement action.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording keeps the matter in allegation status, or otherwise clearly distinguishes the allegation from any finding or resolution.
evaluation.fail_definition: The relation is attempted but the wording presents an allegation as an established finding, or leaves unclear whether the action concerns an allegation or a finding.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require mention of allegations or findings. Do not infer a finding from the existence of a settlement or action.

skills.name: Connect an enforcement document to the conduct it addresses
skills.action: State which conduct a named enforcement document or action addresses.

applicability.description: A report connects a named complaint or enforcement document to the conduct it addresses.

context.scope_limits: Does not require the report to include conduct or a document. This rule does not determine whether conduct occurred.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states both the document or action and conduct, with wording attempting to say that the document addresses or concerns that conduct.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the conduct as the subject addressed by the complaint or action.
evaluation.fail_definition: The document and conduct are mentioned but their relationship is unclear, or the report attributes conduct to the document or party in a way that changes the stated relation.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require the report to include conduct or a document. This rule does not determine whether conduct occurred.

skills.name: Preserve the assessed-penalty role of a monetary amount
skills.action: Label a penalty amount according to its stated assessment or imposition role.

applicability.description: A report states a monetary penalty as an assessed amount.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a penalty amount. Do not infer assessment from a collected amount or treat assessed and collected amounts as equivalent.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively characterizes a monetary amount as a penalty assessed or imposed.
evaluation.pass_definition: The amount is clearly identified as an assessed or imposed penalty, not as an amount collected or paid.
evaluation.fail_definition: The amount is presented as assessed but the wording instead identifies it as collected, paid, or otherwise changes the monetary role, or leaves its role unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a penalty amount. Do not infer assessment from a collected amount or treat assessed and collected amounts as equivalent.

skills.name: Preserve the collected-amount role
skills.action: Describe a monetary amount according to its stated collected or received status.

applicability.description: A report states a monetary amount as collected or already received.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a monetary amount. A collected amount does not establish when it was collected or a payment deadline.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively characterizes an amount as collected or received.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the amount as collected or received without converting it into an assessment or deadline.
evaluation.fail_definition: The amount is presented as collected but the wording changes it to an assessed penalty, a payment deadline, or another monetary status, or leaves the status unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a monetary amount. A collected amount does not establish when it was collected or a payment deadline.

skills.name: Attribute entry of a disposition to the court
skills.action: Express the stated relationship between a court and its entry of a settlement instrument or disposition.

applicability.description: A report expressly states that a court entered a settlement instrument or disposition.

context.scope_limits: Does not require naming a court or describing a judicial entry. Do not conflate court entry with agency issuance.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report names both the court and instrument or disposition and uses wording that assigns the court the act of entering it.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly states that the court entered the named settlement instrument or disposition.
evaluation.fail_definition: The court and instrument are both mentioned but the entry relationship is unclear, or entry is attributed to another actor.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require naming a court or describing a judicial entry. Do not conflate court entry with agency issuance.

skills.name: Discretionary opening and framing choice
skills.action: The observation records a chosen opening frame, event focus, or ordering of case facts.

applicability.description: A writer happens to choose a particular opening, lead, or sequence without expressing a separately assessable relation.

context.scope_limits: Opening position, preferred framing, and order of otherwise independent facts are discretionary; a different coherent opening is acceptable.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses a particular opening frame, foregrounding choice, or element order but does not attempt one of the eligible relational operations above.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not assessed.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable; this group records discretionary opening or ordering choices, not a pass/fail rule.

extensions.scope_limits: Opening position, preferred framing, and order of otherwise independent facts are discretionary; a different coherent opening is acceptable.

skills.name: Optional grouping of case details
skills.action: The observation records bundling or summarizing selected facts about a case.

applicability.description: A report could place related case facts together, but the observation concerns optional grouping, compression, or coverage rather than an independently assessable relation.

context.scope_limits: Do not require every available fact to appear, appear together, or fit in one sentence; absence of an unselected fact is not a failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report combines or compresses multiple case details without attempting a specific eligible relation between them.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not assessed.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable; optional coverage and sentence-level grouping are not pass/fail criteria.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require every available fact to appear, appear together, or fit in one sentence; absence of an unselected fact is not a failure.

skills.name: Simple identification or naming
skills.action: The observation records identifying a party, law, location, or action.

applicability.description: The observation concerns naming an entity, law, location, or action without a distinct assessable relationship.

context.scope_limits: Entity naming, code expansion, and capitalization alone are ineligible; do not require optional identifiers or details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report names one or more case entities or topics without attempting a role relation assessed by another eligible group.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not assessed.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable; simple naming is not a pass/fail writing transformation here.

extensions.scope_limits: Entity naming, code expansion, and capitalization alone are ineligible; do not require optional identifiers or details.

skills.name: Discretionary substantive focus
skills.action: The observation records which substantive issue or conduct the writer chose to foreground.

applicability.description: A report chooses to foreground a substantive topic, allegation, violation category, or compliance issue.

context.scope_limits: Do not require one topic to be selected, placed first, or included; a different coherent focus is acceptable.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report foregrounds a selected topic without attempting a specific eligible relation between that topic and an event, instrument, or party.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not assessed.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable; topic selection and foregrounding alone are discretionary.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require one topic to be selected, placed first, or included; a different coherent focus is acceptable.

skills.name: Link an inspection or evaluation to a subsequent enforcement action
skills.action: When reporting both events, make their temporal relationship clear by identifying the inspection or evaluation as preceding the enforcement action.

applicability.description: When a report positively describes both an inspection or evaluation and a later enforcement action, and explicitly connects the two in the narrative.

context.scope_limits: Assess only the expressed relation between these two events. Do not require either event to be included, infer causation, or enforce a broader event chronology.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report presents an inspection or evaluation and an enforcement action, and wording attempts to state their temporal relationship.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly identifies the inspection or evaluation as preceding the enforcement action, without implying an unsupported causal link.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to say which event preceded the other but expresses the sequence inconsistently or leaves the relationship between the two events unresolved. Merely mentioning both events, or omitting either optional event, is not a failure.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only the expressed relation between these two events. Do not require either event to be included, infer causation, or enforce a broader event chronology.

skills.name: Optional narrative sequencing and focus preferences
skills.action: These observations record witness-preferred arrangements of case context, action, allegations, findings, legal bases, terms, remedies, outcomes, and supporting details.

applicability.description: The observations describe chosen sequences for brief case accounts: for example, context before outcome, outcome before allegations, broad before specific, action before terms, or conduct before consequences. They also include preferred openings, closings, and general readable progressions.

context.scope_limits: This ineligible group preserves the ordering and focus observations as provenance only. Do not turn any observed opening position, chosen sequence, optional coverage, or general readability preference into a rule.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: these observations express optional choices about what information to foreground and where to place it, rather than a specific required relation with an independent report-observable boundary.
evaluation.pass_definition: No pass criterion is assigned because the observations do not establish a required sequence or a distinct logical, temporal, attribution, or integration relation whose expression can be assessed independently.
evaluation.fail_definition: No failure criterion is assigned. A different coherent ordering, focus, or selection of report-supported details is acceptable; omitted optional details are not failures.

extensions.scope_limits: This ineligible group preserves the ordering and focus observations as provenance only. Do not turn any observed opening position, chosen sequence, optional coverage, or general readability preference into a rule.

skills.name: Optional disposition-first presentation
skills.action: A writer may foreground a later outcome and then give the preceding procedural history.

applicability.description: A narrative presents a later disposition and an earlier procedural event.

context.scope_limits: This is an optional document-ordering preference, not a required chronology or a rule about what facts to include.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The narrative presents both events and chooses which to foreground or describe first.
evaluation.pass_definition: The later disposition is presented before the earlier procedural event.
evaluation.fail_definition: The earlier event is presented before the disposition, contrary to the observed ordering preference; this is not an assessable failure because either coherent order is acceptable.

extensions.scope_limits: This is an optional document-ordering preference, not a required chronology or a rule about what facts to include.

skills.name: Express a coherent chronology among events
skills.action: When relating multiple events, make their temporal order coherent and legible.

applicability.description: A report establishes a temporal relationship among multiple events or presents multiple dated determinations in sequence.

context.scope_limits: Assess only chronology expressed in the report; do not compare against hidden input facts, require literal TRAIN dates, or infer a complete timeline. Optional event selection is not a failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report explicitly relates events as earlier or later, or arranges multiple events or determinations as a chronological sequence; merely naming events or giving unrelated dates does not count.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report's expressed earlier/later relation or sequence is coherent with the chronology it itself states. It need not include every event or explain unreported milestones.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted temporal relation is internally inconsistent with the dates or temporal links stated in the report, or the attempted sequence leaves the relevant ordering confused or contradictory.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only chronology expressed in the report; do not compare against hidden input facts, require literal TRAIN dates, or infer a complete timeline. Optional event selection is not a failure.

skills.name: Keep reporting period and filing deadline distinct
skills.action: State an allegation's reporting period separately from its applicable filing deadline.

applicability.description: An allegation is described in relation to both a reporting period and a filing deadline.

context.scope_limits: Assess the distinction between these roles, not whether the report includes every date or any unreported deadline.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively connects an allegation to a reporting period and a filing deadline; mentioning dates without assigning those temporal roles does not count.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear which temporal span is the reporting period and which date is the filing deadline.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to state both roles but collapses them into one date or assigns a date ambiguously or inconsistently between the reporting period and the filing deadline.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess the distinction between these roles, not whether the report includes every date or any unreported deadline.

skills.name: Integrate procedural milestones as beginning and conclusion
skills.action: When summarizing procedural milestones, distinguish those marking the beginning of a matter from those marking its conclusion.

applicability.description: A report summarizes multiple procedural milestones as the beginning and conclusion of a matter.

context.scope_limits: Assess only the expressed relationship between milestones. Simple identification of the respondent is not a separate criterion; do not infer finer timing from milestones stated to share a date.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively presents procedural milestones as marking both the beginning and conclusion of the same matter; merely naming a respondent or mentioning one milestone does not count.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly assigns the selected milestones their beginning and conclusion roles without implying a more detailed chronology than it states.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to assign beginning and conclusion roles but conflates or reverses them, or asserts a temporal sequence that conflicts with its own stated account.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only the expressed relationship between milestones. Simple identification of the respondent is not a separate criterion; do not infer finer timing from milestones stated to share a date.

skills.name: Readable statutory citation
skills.action: Render supplied statute and section identifiers as a readable legal citation, without adding unsupported citation details.

applicability.description: A report renders a supplied statute and/or section identifier as a reader-facing citation.

context.scope_limits: Do not treat abbreviation, punctuation, section formatting, combining identifiers, or optional parallel citations as independently assessable requirements.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to state a statutory reference using statute or section identifiers.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: citation form alone is not an eligible transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: this group is ineligible because citation formatting, code expansion, and identifier presentation alone have no qualifying relational pass/fail boundary.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not treat abbreviation, punctuation, section formatting, combining identifiers, or optional parallel citations as independently assessable requirements.

skills.name: Statute name rendering
skills.action: Render a supplied statute identifier as a reader-facing statute name when chosen.

applicability.description: A report renders a supplied statute code or acronym as a statute name.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a full title, acronym, parenthetical form, or expansion at every mention.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to identify a statute by rendering its supplied code or acronym as a name.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: statute-name rendering alone has no qualifying relational boundary.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: naming or expanding a statute identifier alone is ineligible.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a full title, acronym, parenthetical form, or expansion at every mention.

skills.name: Associate a statutory section with its descriptor
skills.action: When chosen, pair a cited statutory section with the corresponding supplied violation or conduct descriptor.

applicability.description: A report expressly pairs a cited statute section with its corresponding supplied violation or conduct description.

context.scope_limits: Do not require inclusion of every available section or descriptor. The relation is between the cited provision and the descriptor, not proof that the described conduct occurred.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to associate a particular statutory section with a violation category or section description, not merely to cite the law or mention the category.
evaluation.pass_definition: Pass if the report makes clear which supplied violation category or section description corresponds to the cited provision.
evaluation.fail_definition: Fail if the attempted pairing assigns a description to the wrong cited section, leaves the section-description relation unclear, or presents the description as belonging to a different provision.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require inclusion of every available section or descriptor. The relation is between the cited provision and the descriptor, not proof that the described conduct occurred.

skills.name: Relate legal authority to an action or proposition
skills.action: State the relationship between a cited legal authority and the particular action or proposition it governs or supports.

applicability.description: A report attempts to state that an action, event, conduct, prohibition, requirement, or resolution is under, based on, or governed by a cited authority.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer detailed conduct, legal conclusions, or citation content from statute identifiers alone. This group does not require an allegation-versus-finding distinction unless the report expressly attempts to characterize the matter as an allegation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively asserts a relationship between a specific action, event, conduct, prohibition, requirement, or resolution and a statute or section; merely placing a citation near the topic is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: Pass if the report clearly identifies the stated action, event, conduct, prohibition, requirement, or resolution as associated with the cited authority.
evaluation.fail_definition: Fail if the attempted authority-to-matter relationship is absent, unclear, or attaches the cited authority to a different action or proposition than the report states.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer detailed conduct, legal conclusions, or citation content from statute identifiers alone. This group does not require an allegation-versus-finding distinction unless the report expressly attempts to characterize the matter as an allegation.

skills.name: Preserve allegation status
skills.action: Mark a conduct proposition as alleged when the report presents it as an allegation.

applicability.description: A report expressly characterizes conduct associated with a cited provision as an allegation rather than an established finding.

context.scope_limits: Do not require allegation wording when the report makes no such attempt; do not infer that a finding exists from a cited law section or a violation descriptor.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively frames a conduct proposition as alleged or asserted, rather than merely citing a section or describing a violation without an allegation/finding distinction.
evaluation.pass_definition: Pass if the report clearly presents the conduct proposition as alleged and does not conflate that allegation with a finding.
evaluation.fail_definition: Fail if the report attempts allegation framing but states the conduct as an established finding, or otherwise makes the allegation status of that proposition unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require allegation wording when the report makes no such attempt; do not infer that a finding exists from a cited law section or a violation descriptor.

skills.name: Keep a shortened legal reference resolvable
skills.action: Establish a clear antecedent before using a shortened reference to a statute or Act.

applicability.description: A report introduces a legal authority and then uses a shortened reference to it later.

context.scope_limits: Do not require shorthand or a particular first-reference format. Assess only whether an attempted later reference is unambiguous.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to use a later shorthand or pronoun-like legal reference whose antecedent must be recovered from an earlier reference.
evaluation.pass_definition: Pass if the later shorthand clearly identifies the previously introduced authority in context.
evaluation.fail_definition: Fail if the attempted shortened reference has no clear antecedent or could reasonably refer to multiple legal authorities in the report.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require shorthand or a particular first-reference format. Assess only whether an attempted later reference is unambiguous.

skills.name: Optional selection of a provision
skills.action: Select provisions for a summary according to the writer's chosen focus.

applicability.description: A summary has multiple listed legal provisions and selects one or a subset for mention.

context.scope_limits: Do not treat omission of an available provision as a failure or infer that unmentioned provisions are irrelevant.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report makes a selection about which listed provision to mention in a summary.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: choosing a particular provision or omitting other provisions is discretionary.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: optional selection or omission preferences do not create an eligible writing rule.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not treat omission of an available provision as a failure or infer that unmentioned provisions are irrelevant.

skills.name: Regulatory descriptor naming and lexicalization
skills.action: When useful, render supplied legal, program, permit, facility, plan, system, or violation descriptors in concise readable prose without adding unsupported specificity.

applicability.description: Observations whose proposed action is naming, expanding, abbreviating, aggregating, or compressing a legal/program descriptor or category, without a distinct assessable relation beyond the label itself.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer a specific permit, system, violation, requirement, statutory meaning, event, or party attribute from a label alone. Code expansion, entity naming, category naming, and optional compression are not independently eligible.

evaluation.attempt_definition: N/A for eligibility assessment: merely choosing to name or paraphrase a statute, program, rule, facility type, plan, system, permit category, or violation label is not an attempt at an eligible transformation in this bank.
evaluation.pass_definition: No pass is scored. The observation concerns lexical choice or optional descriptor coverage, not a report-observable relational operation.
evaluation.fail_definition: No failure is scored: omitting a label, choosing another coherent label, or using a different degree of expansion is discretionary.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer a specific permit, system, violation, requirement, statutory meaning, event, or party attribute from a label alone. Code expansion, entity naming, category naming, and optional compression are not independently eligible.

skills.name: Qualify conduct with its regulatory context
skills.action: Link a supported regulatory topic or requirement to the conduct or requirement it qualifies.

applicability.description: When supplied program or law terminology is used to characterize conduct or a requirement as belonging to that regulatory topic.

context.scope_limits: This does not require naming every available program descriptor or stating a specific statutory prohibition. Do not add unsupported circumstances or convert a general topic label into a violation finding.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively presents conduct or a requirement as being under, concerning, or subject to a stated program, law topic, or regulatory requirement; merely naming the program or mentioning conduct separately is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The prose makes clear which conduct or requirement is qualified by the stated regulatory topic or requirement, without implying facts not supplied.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the qualification but leaves the relationship unclear, or attaches the topic to a different subject so the reader cannot tell what conduct or requirement it qualifies.

extensions.scope_limits: This does not require naming every available program descriptor or stating a specific statutory prohibition. Do not add unsupported circumstances or convert a general topic label into a violation finding.

skills.name: Link a program to its statutory authority
skills.action: State the relationship between a program and its supplied statutory authority.

applicability.description: When a report both identifies a program and states that it is based on, or derives authority from, a supplied statute.

context.scope_limits: Do not add statutory subsections or delegation status not supported by the source. A concise combined label without an expressed authority relationship does not satisfy the operation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively asserts a statutory-authority relationship for the named program; stating the statute and program side by side without connecting them is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the supplied statute as the authority or basis for the program, at the level of specificity supported by the record.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the linkage but leaves unclear which statute authorizes or underlies the program, or reverses or otherwise confuses the relationship.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not add statutory subsections or delegation status not supported by the source. A concise combined label without an expressed authority relationship does not satisfy the operation.

skills.name: Link an allegation to its legal authority
skills.action: Connect an identified legal authority to the conduct or reporting violations alleged under it.

applicability.description: When allegations and a legal statute or program are both discussed and the report states their legal relationship.

context.scope_limits: This operation does not establish the truth of the allegations or require that every available legal citation be included. Do not turn an allegation into a finding.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively characterizes stated conduct or reporting violations as alleged under, pursuant to, or otherwise governed by the identified statute or program; merely naming both is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The prose clearly assigns the identified legal authority to the conduct or reporting violations as allegations, preserving their alleged status.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the relationship but makes unclear which allegation is under which authority, or states the allegation as an established finding rather than the supported allegation.

extensions.scope_limits: This operation does not establish the truth of the allegations or require that every available legal citation be included. Do not turn an allegation into a finding.

skills.name: Connect a legal provision's prohibition to alleged conduct
skills.action: Explain the relevant prohibition of a cited provision and connect it to the conduct described as alleged.

applicability.description: When a report identifies an applicable statutory provision and explains the prohibition relevant to described alleged conduct.

context.scope_limits: Use only the statutory meaning and conduct supported by the report's source material. Do not require a quotation or a full statutory paraphrase.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively explains what the cited provision prohibits and relates that prohibition to the described conduct; citing the provision, paraphrasing a rule without connecting it to conduct, or describing conduct without the rule is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The prose identifies the applicable provision, explains its pertinent prohibition, and makes the relationship between that prohibition and the described conduct clear without presenting an allegation as a finding.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the explanation but leaves unclear what the provision prohibits or how that prohibition relates to the described conduct, or attributes the rule to the wrong provision.

extensions.scope_limits: Use only the statutory meaning and conduct supported by the report's source material. Do not require a quotation or a full statutory paraphrase.

skills.name: Present the governing rule before the case facts
skills.action: State and explain the relevant legal rule before presenting the case-specific facts it governs.

applicability.description: When the report frames case-specific facts with a supplied statutory provision and its relevant rule.

context.scope_limits: This is a specific rule-before-facts relationship, not a requirement to place legal context at an arbitrary opening position. Do not require a particular quotation length.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively presents the rule or prohibition of the cited provision before introducing the case-specific facts it governs; merely including both in any order is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The cited provision's relevant rule is explained before the case-specific facts, and the prose makes clear that the rule applies to those facts.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts this framing but presents case-specific facts before the rule, or the stated rule is not clearly the one governing those facts.

extensions.scope_limits: This is a specific rule-before-facts relationship, not a requirement to place legal context at an arbitrary opening position. Do not require a particular quotation length.

skills.name: Link a program to its associated permit or requirements
skills.action: Express the supported association between a regulatory program and its related permit or requirements.

applicability.description: When a report refers both to a program and to a permit or requirements associated with it.

context.scope_limits: The input does not identify an individual permit, its issuer, or its terms. Naming the program alone is not an attempt at this operation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively identifies a permit or requirements as associated with the named program; naming the program and permit separately without expressing their association is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The prose makes the program-to-permit or program-to-requirements association clear without implying a specific permit number, issuer, or term.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the association but leaves unclear which permit or requirements belong with the program, or asserts a more specific identity or terms not supported by the source.

extensions.scope_limits: The input does not identify an individual permit, its issuer, or its terms. Naming the program alone is not an attempt at this operation.

skills.name: Express the relationship between related program descriptors
skills.action: State the supported relationship between a program descriptor and its related subject-area descriptor.

applicability.description: When supplied program descriptors denote related subject-area and program concepts that the report presents together.

context.scope_limits: This operation concerns the relationship among supplied descriptors only. Do not infer specific requirements, violations, or enforcement events from the labels.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively expresses one descriptor as the subject area or component associated with the other; simply listing or combining the names without that relationship is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The prose clearly identifies the supplied subject area and its associated program, without inferring requirements absent from the source.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the association but leaves the subject-area/program relationship unclear or makes the descriptors appear to be unrelated programs.

extensions.scope_limits: This operation concerns the relationship among supplied descriptors only. Do not infer specific requirements, violations, or enforcement events from the labels.

skills.name: Attribute a misbranding condition to an item's labeling
skills.action: Express a supported misbranding category as a labeling condition of the relevant item.

applicability.description: When a report describes a relevant item using a supplied misbranding category as a condition of that item's labeling.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer additional particulars about the label, product, or violation beyond the supplied category.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively attributes the misbranding condition to the labeling of a relevant item; mentioning an item and a misbranding category separately is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The prose clearly presents the supported misbranding category as a condition of the relevant item's labeling without adding unsupported label details.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the attribution but leaves unclear which item's labeling has the condition, or attaches the condition to something other than the item's labeling.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer additional particulars about the label, product, or violation beyond the supplied category.

skills.name: Relate an action to its legal authority
skills.action: State the supported legal authority as the basis for the particular action or instrument, keeping authority distinct from the instrument itself.

applicability.description: A report explicitly states that a statute or provision is the legal basis or authority for an agency action, order, remedy, or enforcement instrument.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer a legal-basis relation from a statute’s mere presence, supply an unsupported section, or imply that an authority is the instrument’s issuer.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that an identified action or instrument is taken, issued, authorized, or governed under a legal authority.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the action or instrument and states which supplied legal authority supports or governs it.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to state the action’s legal basis but leaves the authority-action relation unclear, attaches the authority to the wrong action, or instead presents the authority only as an unrelated citation.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer a legal-basis relation from a statute’s mere presence, supply an unsupported section, or imply that an authority is the instrument’s issuer.

skills.name: Relate conduct or a violation to its governing provision
skills.action: Connect the described conduct or violation to its corresponding legal provision or requirement.

applicability.description: A report states a conduct, duty, requirement, or violation and relates it to a corresponding legal provision or regulatory subject, without making allegation status the defining distinction.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer case facts, legal elements, statutory sections, or a specific mapping absent from the report. Citation formatting or a law name alone is not the relation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively links described conduct, a duty, requirement, or violation to a law, provision, or regulatory requirement.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly expresses which conduct, duty, requirement, or violation is associated with the identified provision, at the level of specificity supported by the narrative.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the conduct-to-law relation but does not make clear which conduct or requirement is governed by the cited law, or falsely joins distinct conduct and provisions.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer case facts, legal elements, statutory sections, or a specific mapping absent from the report. Citation formatting or a law name alone is not the relation.

skills.name: Preserve allegation status in a conduct-to-law relation
skills.action: Relate the alleged conduct to its supported legal provision while making clear that it is alleged.

applicability.description: The report frames conduct as alleged, accused, or claimed to violate a stated legal provision or duty.

context.scope_limits: This rule concerns the expressed status of an attempted allegation, not whether another optional allegation is included or whether the allegation is true.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively connects a conduct or duty proposition to a legal provision while presenting that conduct or duty as an allegation.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly links the alleged conduct or duty to the relevant provision and retains its allegation status rather than presenting it as an established finding.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts this allegation-to-law relation but leaves the alleged conduct-to-provision link unclear, or its wording changes the allegation into an established finding or omits the qualification so the status is conflated.

extensions.scope_limits: This rule concerns the expressed status of an attempted allegation, not whether another optional allegation is included or whether the allegation is true.

skills.name: Identify the subject of a legal finding
skills.action: State the finding and explicitly connect it to its relevant subject and supported legal basis.

applicability.description: The report presents a finding or legal conclusion and relates it to a party, conduct, violation category, or provision.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer that a finding exists from statute or violation fields alone; this rule assesses the expressed relation, not the correctness of the finding.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states a finding or conclusion and connects it to the relevant entity, conduct, violation, or legal provision.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies what or whom the finding concerns and how the stated legal provision or violation category relates to it.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the finding-to-subject relation but leaves its subject or legal connection ambiguous, or phrases an allegation as a finding without signaling the distinction.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer that a finding exists from statute or violation fields alone; this rule assesses the expressed relation, not the correctness of the finding.

skills.name: Relate an enforcement action to the violation it addresses
skills.action: Connect the named enforcement action or resolution to the violation or conduct it addresses.

applicability.description: A report relates an enforcement action, settlement, order, notice, or resolution to the violation or conduct it addresses, where the action-to-violation relation is the core operation.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer the action’s legal basis, procedural status, or specific violation details unless the report states them; those are separate relations.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that an enforcement action addresses, resolves, concerns, or is based on a specified violation or conduct.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the action and the violation or conduct it addresses, resolves, or is based on.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to connect the action to a violation or conduct but leaves which violation the action addresses unclear, or makes the action and violation appear unrelated.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer the action’s legal basis, procedural status, or specific violation details unless the report states them; those are separate relations.

skills.name: Relate an activity to program authority
skills.action: State that the described activity was conducted under the identified program’s authority.

applicability.description: The report states that an activity was conducted under the authority of a named program.

context.scope_limits: A program field alone does not establish legal jurisdiction or authority; assess only the relation expressed in the report.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively characterizes an activity as conducted under a program’s authority.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the activity and the program whose authority it says governs that activity.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts that relation but leaves unclear which program’s authority governs which activity, or merely names the program without asserting authority over the activity.

extensions.scope_limits: A program field alone does not establish legal jurisdiction or authority; assess only the relation expressed in the report.

skills.name: Relate conduct to a standard of legal conformity
skills.action: State the asserted conformity relation between the activity and the named statute or standard.

applicability.description: The report expressly states that an activity or conduct is in accordance with a statute or other legal standard.

context.scope_limits: Keep conformity distinct from legal authority: do not treat “under the authority of” as equivalent to “in accordance with.” Assess the expressed claim, not its truth.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively asserts that an activity or conduct complies with, or is in accordance with, a named legal standard.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the activity and the legal standard to which it says the activity conforms.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the conformity assertion but does not make clear which activity is said to conform to which standard, or wording instead suggests only that the standard authorized the activity.

extensions.scope_limits: Keep conformity distinct from legal authority: do not treat “under the authority of” as equivalent to “in accordance with.” Assess the expressed claim, not its truth.

skills.name: Make a later reference to legal authorities unambiguous
skills.action: Use a clear reference when carrying previously introduced legal authorities into a later proposition.

applicability.description: A later report unit refers to legal authorities introduced earlier and uses a reference such as “these” or “those” to connect them to later conduct or a compliance action.

context.scope_limits: Do not require repeated citations when no cross-reference is attempted; assess only the reference and relation actually expressed.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively uses a later reference to previously introduced legal authorities in a claim about an action, requirement, or compliance.
evaluation.pass_definition: The referenced legal authority or authorities have a clear antecedent, and the later action or compliance proposition is clearly related to them.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts this cross-unit relation but the reference has multiple plausible antecedents or does not clearly connect the earlier authorities to the later action or requirement.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require repeated citations when no cross-reference is attempted; assess only the reference and relation actually expressed.

skills.name: Keep multiple violation categories mapped to their respective authorities
skills.action: When grouping multiple categories, preserve the stated category-to-authority associations.

applicability.description: A report summarizes multiple distinct violation or reporting categories and relates them to their respective statutes or programs.

context.scope_limits: This applies only when the report attempts a multi-category mapping. A single listed item creates no coordination requirement, and omitted optional categories are not failures.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively groups or maps multiple categories to legal authorities or programs.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report’s grouping makes clear which stated authority or program corresponds to each category it includes.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts a multi-category mapping but leaves which authority belongs to which category unclear or collapses distinct categories into an ambiguous grouping.

extensions.scope_limits: This applies only when the report attempts a multi-category mapping. A single listed item creates no coordination requirement, and omitted optional categories are not failures.

skills.name: Preserve qualification when applying a legal ground to facts
skills.action: Apply the stated legal ground to the case facts while keeping the source’s qualification attached to that application.

applicability.description: The report states a legal ground and applies it to case facts using an explicit qualification such as “appears.”

context.scope_limits: Assess only a qualification the report attempts to express. Do not require a legal application or qualification where none is stated.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively applies a legal ground or category to case facts while expressing a qualification about that application.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly connects the relevant facts to the legal ground and preserves the expressed degree of qualification.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the qualified application but leaves unclear which facts are being assessed under the legal ground, or its wording drops, reverses, or misattaches the qualification.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only a qualification the report attempts to express. Do not require a legal application or qualification where none is stated.

skills.name: Legal-label naming or expansion only
skills.action: Name or expand a supplied legal label; no relational transformation is assessed here.

applicability.description: The report only names, expands, or renders a statute, section, acronym, or legal descriptor, without an assessable relation to conduct, an action, or another proposition.

context.scope_limits: Do not turn citation format, acronym expansion, or a preference for statutory labels into a pass/fail rule. The group is ineligible.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report performs only legal-entity naming, code expansion, citation rendering, or descriptor lexicalization.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable; this group preserves provenance for observations that concern naming or lexicalization alone.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: these observations do not establish an independently assessable writing transformation beyond naming or rendering legal labels.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not turn citation format, acronym expansion, or a preference for statutory labels into a pass/fail rule. The group is ineligible.

skills.name: Connect alleged conduct to its legal basis
skills.action: State the conduct or violation and connect it to the applicable statute, rule, permit requirement, or legal provision.

applicability.description: When a narrative links alleged conduct or noncompliance to an applicable rule, statute, permit requirement, or legal provision.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a citation, provision number, factual detail, or legal conclusion unless the report attempts to provide it. A topic mention or provision name alone is not an attempted link.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states both a violation or alleged conduct and the legal requirement that governs or prohibits it, with wording connecting them.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly connects the stated conduct or violation to the identified governing requirement, without implying more legal specificity than it states.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the link but leaves unclear which conduct is governed by which provision, or presents the cited legal basis as unrelated to the stated violation.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a citation, provision number, factual detail, or legal conclusion unless the report attempts to provide it. A topic mention or provision name alone is not an attempted link.

skills.name: Realize a violation category as conduct
skills.action: Express a violation category as the corresponding alleged action, omission, or failure, parameterizing the conduct and document involved.

applicability.description: When a report turns a broad violation or reporting category into an allegation about a particular kind of failure or conduct.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer a particular document, period, actor, standard, or violation instance from a broad category. An omitted optional detail is not a failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively describes an act, omission, or failure as the conduct underlying a violation category.
evaluation.pass_definition: The stated action or omission is intelligible as the conduct being alleged or described, while any report-specific document or activity remains clearly identified.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to state the conduct but its wording does not identify the relevant action or omission, or describes a different kind of conduct within the same proposition.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer a particular document, period, actor, standard, or violation instance from a broad category. An omitted optional detail is not a failure.

skills.name: Map an actor to the stated action
skills.action: Name the relevant actor or role and state the action attributed to that actor.

applicability.description: When a report attributes an alleged action, omission, or disclosure to a named party or role.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer the actor's identity from a violation category or require actor details the report does not attempt to state. For a submission event, a date alone is not an attempted actor-action mapping.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that a party or actor performed or failed to perform an action.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear who is said to have performed, omitted, disclosed, or submitted the item in question.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts an actor-action statement but leaves the actor unclear, attaches the action to the wrong stated role, or makes the actor-action relation grammatically ambiguous.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer the actor's identity from a violation category or require actor details the report does not attempt to state. For a submission event, a date alone is not an attempted actor-action mapping.

skills.name: Attach a status or limit to the qualified conduct
skills.action: Place the relevant status or limit in a clear relation to the activity, item, or discharge it qualifies.

applicability.description: When a report states a permit, registration, threshold, or other status/condition as a qualification of a particular activity, item, or discharge.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a status claim to be made. Do not infer a measured value, permit name, item identity, or legal consequence not stated by the report.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively expresses both the qualified activity or item and a status, condition, or limit that applies to it.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly identifies which activity, item, or discharge is without a permit, exceeds a limit, or has the stated regulatory status.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the qualification but attaches the status or limit to the wrong item or conduct, or leaves the qualified relationship unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a status claim to be made. Do not infer a measured value, permit name, item identity, or legal consequence not stated by the report.

skills.name: Coordinate distinct violation particulars without conflating them
skills.action: Coordinate multiple violation particulars while preserving their distinct identities and any stated relation between them.

applicability.description: When a report presents two or more distinct alleged violation particulars together.

context.scope_limits: Only applies when at least two distinct particulars are expressed. Do not require an exhaustive list or penalize omission of optional categories.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively coordinates or groups multiple distinct violation descriptions as particulars of the same account.
evaluation.pass_definition: The coordinated particulars remain distinguishable, and the wording does not imply that they are interchangeable or that one necessarily caused the other.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to coordinate multiple particulars but merges them so their distinct conduct or categories become materially ambiguous, or makes the coordination imply a relation the wording does not support.

extensions.scope_limits: Only applies when at least two distinct particulars are expressed. Do not require an exhaustive list or penalize omission of optional categories.

skills.name: Distinguish an alleged omission from a later submission
skills.action: Contrast an alleged missed submission with any later submission as separate events, preserving their order and stated relationship.

applicability.description: When a report contrasts an alleged earlier omission with a later submission or completed event.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a cure determination, recipient, or date unless the report attempts to state it. Mentioning only one event does not trigger this rule.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states both the omission and a later submission or completion, using wording that relates the two events.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly presents the omission and later submission as distinct events in the stated order, without equating later submission with complete cure unless expressly stated.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the contrast but makes the event order unclear, treats the later event as if it erased the earlier allegation without saying so, or leaves unclear which item was later submitted.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a cure determination, recipient, or date unless the report attempts to state it. Mentioning only one event does not trigger this rule.

skills.name: Relate a required notice to its audience and subject
skills.action: Describe a notification event or requirement by relating the notice to its stated audience and subject.

applicability.description: When a report describes a notification obligation or violation and identifies the intended audience or notice subject.

context.scope_limits: Do not require an audience or notice subject that the report does not select. Do not infer the contents of an unstated notice.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively relates a notice or notification to an identified audience, affected group, or subject.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear who the notice was directed to and, if it states a subject, what the notice concerned.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the audience-notice relation but leaves unclear who was to receive the notice or what the notice concerned.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require an audience or notice subject that the report does not select. Do not infer the contents of an unstated notice.

skills.name: Attach an exception to the conduct it qualifies
skills.action: State the conduct and attach any stated exception or compliance condition directly to that conduct.

applicability.description: When a report states prohibited or ordered conduct together with an exception or condition under which it is permitted.

context.scope_limits: Do not require an exception, infer its legal scope, or add options or steps absent from the report.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states both the conduct and an exception, qualification, or compliance condition that limits it.
evaluation.pass_definition: The stated exception or condition clearly limits the specific conduct described, and the report distinguishes the qualified rule from the exception.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the qualification but its wording makes the exception appear to apply to a different action, or leaves the prohibited conduct and its exception in conflict or ambiguous relation.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require an exception, infer its legal scope, or add options or steps absent from the report.

skills.name: Preserve allegation-versus-finding status
skills.action: Mark the stated claim with its report-expressed status—allegation, attributed assertion, or finding.

applicability.description: When a report presents a matter as an allegation rather than an adjudicated finding, or expressly distinguishes those statuses.

context.scope_limits: This rule concerns only status expressed in the report; do not check underlying truth or require a status label when the report makes no such claim.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively characterizes a proposition as alleged, asserted by an agency or party, or found/adjudicated.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report's wording accurately signals whether the proposition is an allegation, an attributed claim, or a finding, without converting one status into another.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts a status characterization but its wording presents an allegation as an established finding, or makes the source/status of the claim materially unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: This rule concerns only status expressed in the report; do not check underlying truth or require a status label when the report makes no such claim.

skills.name: Integrate a legal summary with the preceding allegation
skills.action: After a detailed account, provide a concise legal or violation summary that clearly refers to that account.

applicability.description: When a report first gives a detailed allegation and then summarizes it by legal category or statutory basis.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a summary or penalize omission of details that the summary is intended to compress.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively provides a preceding detailed account and a later summary that refers back to it as a legal or violation characterization.
evaluation.pass_definition: The summary is recognizably about the preceding alleged conduct and preserves its stated legal category or basis without needing to repeat every detail.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the summary but the summary cannot be connected to the preceding account, or appears to change the category or legal basis of that account.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a summary or penalize omission of details that the summary is intended to compress.

skills.name: Descriptor rendering or wording choice
skills.action: Render the selected supported descriptor in readable prose, parameterizing the term and any abbreviation.

applicability.description: When the report renders a code, descriptor, program label, legal category, or abbreviation in prose without a distinct relational operation.

context.scope_limits: Does not impose a preferred synonym, expansion, capitalization, category label, or degree of detail.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: the observation concerns naming, paraphrasing, expanding, abbreviating, or selecting a descriptor alone.
