evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: this group preserves observations about prose labels and lexical choices without creating a checklist vote.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: no independent report-observable relational pass/fail boundary is established by descriptor wording alone.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not impose a preferred synonym, expansion, capitalization, category label, or degree of detail.

skills.name: Import classification wording
skills.action: Render an import-related classification in concise prose when selected.

applicability.description: When an import-related enforcement classification is rendered as an import, imported item, or shipment phrase without a separate event-role relation.

context.scope_limits: Does not establish shipment identity, timing, destination, refusal, return, or contents; those are separate claims.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: the observation concerns lexicalizing an import classification as a prose label.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: this group preserves the provenance of import-related wording observations without enforcing a phrase.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: no nontrivial relation boundary is established by naming an import or imported item.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not establish shipment identity, timing, destination, refusal, return, or contents; those are separate claims.

skills.name: Status descriptor wording
skills.action: Use a selected status descriptor as a modifier of the relevant item.

applicability.description: When the observation concerns naming a registration or other status as a modifier, without expressing a distinct status-to-item relation beyond the modifier.

context.scope_limits: Does not determine whether the status is true for an item or require the report to mention that status.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: the observation concerns status terminology or a status label alone.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: this preserves status-naming observations without requiring a particular modifier.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: status naming alone has no distinct structural boundary for this bank.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not determine whether the status is true for an item or require the report to mention that status.

skills.name: Optional category aggregation
skills.action: Summarize or combine selected categories only when that is a coherent choice for the report.

applicability.description: When the observation concerns an optional summary or combination of categories without a necessary relation among the selected facts.

context.scope_limits: Does not require inclusion of all available categories or treat related categories as interchangeable.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: the observation reflects a choice to aggregate, generalize, combine, or omit optional categories.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: this group retains the observation while avoiding a rule that requires any particular coverage or grouping.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: alternative coherent choices of coverage or level of summary cannot be failed structurally.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require inclusion of all available categories or treat related categories as interchangeable.

skills.name: Untraceable or case-specific detail
skills.action: Use a case-specific detail only when the report itself supports and coherently relates it.

applicability.description: When an observation proposes factual particulars or qualifications not established by the cited fields.

context.scope_limits: Does not infer the truth, identity, amount, period, product, filing status, method, or causal relation from absent fields.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: the observation depends on case-specific details not represented in the supplied description.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: this group preserves the observation but does not enforce the proposed particular.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: hidden input truth or unsupported literal TRAIN particulars cannot be used as a pass/fail criterion.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not infer the truth, identity, amount, period, product, filing status, method, or causal relation from absent fields.

skills.name: Optional focus selection
skills.action: Select and order report details according to the report's communicative purpose.

applicability.description: When a witness's observation is about which topic, violation, or detail to foreground rather than a necessary relation in the report.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a particular opening position, foregrounded violation, or inclusion of optional facts.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: the observation expresses a preference about focus or opening emphasis.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: this group preserves focus observations without requiring a particular topic or position.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: optional focus and ordering preferences do not establish a report-observable failure boundary.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a particular opening position, foregrounded violation, or inclusion of optional facts.

skills.name: Attribute an allegation to its source
skills.action: State who alleges what about which party, preserving the claim as an allegation.

applicability.description: A report positively presents conduct as an agency allegation.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer the source of an allegation from an agency lead field alone. This rule does not establish the truth of the allegation or require inclusion of optional case details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states that an identifiable agency or authority alleges, claims, or asserts conduct by an identifiable party.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the agency or authority as the source of the allegation and the party or conduct to which it relates, without treating the allegation as an established finding.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts that attribution but leaves the alleging source or the allegation's subject unclear, assigns a source to the wrong role, or presents the allegation as an unattributed fact.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer the source of an allegation from an agency lead field alone. This rule does not establish the truth of the allegation or require inclusion of optional case details.

skills.name: Map the party to the alleged conduct
skills.action: Identify the party as the actor or responsible subject of the conduct being described.

applicability.description: A report positively describes alleged conduct by a party.

context.scope_limits: Do not treat an activity, facility, or case name as interchangeable with a defendant unless the report makes that relation clear. The rule does not require stating any particular conduct.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states or paraphrases an action or failure and assigns an identifiable case party the role of actor or responsible subject.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes the intended party's role as actor or responsible subject of the stated conduct clear.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to assign the actor role but leaves the actor ambiguous, assigns the conduct to a different participant, or makes the party only an object or setting rather than the stated actor.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not treat an activity, facility, or case name as interchangeable with a defendant unless the report makes that relation clear. The rule does not require stating any particular conduct.

skills.name: Link conduct to its legal basis
skills.action: Connect the conduct or violation claim to the law, permit, or requirement it is said to implicate.

applicability.description: A report connects described conduct or an alleged violation to a legal provision or requirement.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer specific violation facts from a statute or general violation category. Naming a law without relating it to conduct does not attempt this operation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly links conduct or a violation claim to a statute, permit, or other legal requirement.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly connects the stated conduct or violation claim to the relevant legal authority or requirement.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the link but leaves unclear which conduct or claim is governed by the cited authority, or states a legal basis as though it were the conduct itself.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer specific violation facts from a statute or general violation category. Naming a law without relating it to conduct does not attempt this operation.

skills.name: Preserve allegation status
skills.action: Qualify conduct as alleged when the report presents it as an allegation rather than a finding.

applicability.description: A report presents conduct whose status as alleged, rather than established, is material to the passage.

context.scope_limits: Do not require an allegation qualifier when a report makes no claim about the conduct's status. This rule does not determine the case's ultimate factual or legal outcome.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report characterizes conduct or a violation as alleged, claimed, or otherwise not established as a finding.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording consistently presents the conduct as alleged rather than as an independently established finding.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to describe the conduct's status but treats an allegation as a finding or uses wording that leaves the stated status internally contradictory.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require an allegation qualifier when a report makes no claim about the conduct's status. This rule does not determine the case's ultimate factual or legal outcome.

skills.name: Attribute and qualify an evidentiary assertion
skills.action: Identify the stated evidentiary or assessment basis for an assertion and retain its expressed qualification.

applicability.description: A report states or qualifies an enforcement assertion by reference to evidence, an agency assessment, or an expressed level of certainty.

context.scope_limits: Do not invent evidence, its contents, or a certainty level absent from the report. Allegation-versus-finding status is assessed separately.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly identifies evidence or an agency assessment as the basis for a claim, or uses a qualification such as apparent, opinion, or indicated to characterize its certainty.
evaluation.pass_definition: The stated evidence or assessment is clearly connected to the assertion, and the report preserves the degree of certainty it expresses.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to state the evidentiary or qualified basis but assigns it to the wrong source, makes the relationship unclear, or states a qualified assertion as certain.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not invent evidence, its contents, or a certainty level absent from the report. Allegation-versus-finding status is assessed separately.

skills.name: Attribute a finding to its subject
skills.action: State who made the finding and identify the person or organization it concerns.

applicability.description: A report states an agency finding or determination about an identifiable party.

context.scope_limits: Do not turn allegation wording into a finding or infer a finding from an enforcement-type field. This rule does not require the report to include a finding.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively presents an agency finding or determination and identifies a person or organization as its subject.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the agency as the source of the finding and the party to whom the finding applies.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to identify the finding's subject but leaves the subject unclear, assigns the finding to the wrong participant, or presents an allegation as though it were the stated finding.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not turn allegation wording into a finding or infer a finding from an enforcement-type field. This rule does not require the report to include a finding.

skills.name: Resolve a participant reference across text
skills.action: Carry a participant or finding reference across adjacent text with an unambiguous link to its content.

applicability.description: A report carries a participant or finding reference across adjacent text.

context.scope_limits: This concerns genuine cross-clause or cross-sentence reference, not a preference for repeating a full name. A single mention does not create a reference-resolution requirement.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report introduces a participant or finding in one clause or sentence and uses a later clause or sentence to state related conduct or finding content.
evaluation.pass_definition: A reader can identify the participant or finding to which the later clause or sentence refers and understand the relation between them.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts this continuation but the later reference has an unclear or competing antecedent, or the relation between the introduced participant or finding and the later content is not recoverable.

extensions.scope_limits: This concerns genuine cross-clause or cross-sentence reference, not a preference for repeating a full name. A single mention does not create a reference-resolution requirement.

skills.name: Distinguish allegations from their resolution
skills.action: Present alleged conduct as an allegation and describe the resolution using its stated outcome or agreement status.

applicability.description: A report presents both alleged conduct and a resolution addressing it.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer adjudication, agreement terms, or resolution effects beyond what the report states.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively relates a stated resolution, agreement, or outcome to conduct it has presented as alleged.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report keeps the alleged conduct distinct from the agreement or outcome and clearly states how the resolution relates to it.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the relation but blurs which content is alleged and which describes the resolution, or states the resolution as proof that the allegation was established when the report does not say so.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer adjudication, agreement terms, or resolution effects beyond what the report states.

skills.name: Distinguish initial and follow-up reporting actions
skills.action: When describing separate initial and follow-up reporting actions, distinguish their roles and order.

applicability.description: A report describes separate initial and follow-up reporting actions or duties in one alleged event.

context.scope_limits: Apply only when the report attempts to describe both actions. Do not infer timing or require mention of an unselected action.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly relates an initial reporting action or failure to a distinct later or follow-up reporting action or failure.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly distinguishes the initial action or duty from the later follow-up action or duty and expresses their temporal relation accurately.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to distinguish the two actions but collapses them into one, reverses their temporal relation, or leaves unclear which action was initial and which was follow-up.

extensions.scope_limits: Apply only when the report attempts to describe both actions. Do not infer timing or require mention of an unselected action.

skills.name: Relate a specific filing to a reporting violation
skills.action: When the report specifies a filing involved in a reporting violation, link that filing to the violation claim.

applicability.description: A report elaborates a general reporting-related violation by naming a particular filing or report allegedly involved.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer a filing type from a broad reporting category. Omitting an optional filing detail is not a failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively connects a specified filing or report type to a general reporting-related violation.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the particular filing or report type as the subject or subtype of the stated reporting violation.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts that connection but leaves unclear which filing is alleged to be missing, deficient, or otherwise implicated.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer a filing type from a broad reporting category. Omitting an optional filing detail is not a failure.

skills.name: Optional allegation heading or label
skills.action: A heading may identify following content as allegations.

applicability.description: A report chooses a heading or label to introduce allegations.

context.scope_limits: Headings and labels are optional presentation choices; absence or alternative placement is not a failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses a heading or standalone label to frame the status of following content.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not assessed.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not assessed: heading choice or label wording alone has no eligible report-observable failure boundary here.

extensions.scope_limits: Headings and labels are optional presentation choices; absence or alternative placement is not a failure.

skills.name: Optional packaging, opening, or order
skills.action: A report may combine related details or choose their order.

applicability.description: A report combines facts, chooses an opening or order, or packages independent information.

context.scope_limits: Do not create a rule from one witness's preferred sentence aggregation or order. A specific logical or temporal conflation is assessed under its relevant eligible group.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report chooses to combine or sequence otherwise independent content for concision or emphasis.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not assessed.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not assessed: optional combination, opening position, or ordering preference alone has no eligible failure boundary.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not create a rule from one witness's preferred sentence aggregation or order. A specific logical or temporal conflation is assessed under its relevant eligible group.

skills.name: Simple naming or lexicalization choice
skills.action: A report may name a party or use a broader term for a recorded description.

applicability.description: An observation concerns naming, capitalization, expanding a code, or substituting a broader lexical description without an independently assessable relation.

context.scope_limits: A naming choice is not a requirement to repeat a full name or use a particular synonym. A genuinely ambiguous participant role is assessed separately.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report names an entity, expands a code, or chooses a broader term.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not assessed.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not assessed: naming and lexical choice alone do not establish a relation-based pass/fail boundary.

extensions.scope_limits: A naming choice is not a requirement to repeat a full name or use a particular synonym. A genuinely ambiguous participant role is assessed separately.

skills.name: Unsupported determination from an enforcement-type label
skills.action: Do not treat a recorded enforcement type by itself as proof of an agency determination.

applicability.description: A report describes an enforcement type and characterizes it as a determination or as appropriate without separately stating that determination.

context.scope_limits: The label may identify the response type but does not independently establish the agency's reasoning or appropriateness determination.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report converts an enforcement-type label into a statement that an agency determined a response was appropriate.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not assessed.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not assessed: this conversion may infer a determination not established by the enforcement-type label.

extensions.scope_limits: The label may identify the response type but does not independently establish the agency's reasoning or appropriateness determination.

skills.name: Coordinate distinct findings without collapsing them
skills.action: Coordinate selected distinct findings or categories in one proposition while preserving their separate meanings.

applicability.description: When a writer chooses to state multiple distinct findings, allegations, or requirement categories together.

context.scope_limits: This assesses only the relation among items the writer chose to include. It does not require combining findings, listing every available item, or preserving a particular sequence.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively coordinates two or more distinct findings or categories as parts of one proposition or phrase.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report expresses the items as coordinated, and each remains identifiable as a distinct finding or category.
evaluation.fail_definition: The coordinated wording makes distinct findings appear to be one finding, or leaves the relation between the coordinated items unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: This assesses only the relation among items the writer chose to include. It does not require combining findings, listing every available item, or preserving a particular sequence.

skills.name: Mark an additional violation as distinct
skills.action: Use an explicit additive or equivalent relation to distinguish a newly presented violation from one already described.

applicability.description: When a writer presents another violation in relation to one already described.

context.scope_limits: Does not require any particular transition word, order, or inclusion of otherwise optional violations.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively introduces a violation as additional to, or separate from, a previously stated violation.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear that the later violation is an additional, distinct violation, without implying an unsupported causal or temporal relation.
evaluation.fail_definition: The wording attempts to mark an additional violation but instead makes it appear to be part of the prior violation, or does not make the additive relation recoverable.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require any particular transition word, order, or inclusion of otherwise optional violations.

skills.name: Keep a shared actor reference clear
skills.action: Use a shared actor reference across coordinated actions only where the report makes its scope clear.

applicability.description: When one actor is expressed as responsible for multiple coordinated actions or allegation clauses.

context.scope_limits: Assesses expressed actor attribution, not whether the actor or alleged conduct is factually correct. Does not require subject omission or a particular sentence structure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses one actor reference to govern at least two coordinated actions or clauses, whether by repeating or carrying forward the reference.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes the actor for each coordinated action clear and consistent.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted shared reference leaves it unclear which actor performs an action, or appears to assign an action to a different actor.

extensions.scope_limits: Assesses expressed actor attribution, not whether the actor or alleged conduct is factually correct. Does not require subject omission or a particular sentence structure.

skills.name: Relate distinct outcomes to a shared enforcement conclusion
skills.action: Present selected distinct outcomes together while preserving their respective roles and their relation to the shared enforcement conclusion.

applicability.description: When a report presents multiple recorded outcomes together under one enforcement conclusion or governing order.

context.scope_limits: Does not require mentioning every outcome or imply that the outcomes have the same legal or procedural status.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively connects at least two distinct outcomes as records or consequences under the same stated enforcement conclusion or order.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report identifies the outcomes as distinct and makes their shared relationship to the stated conclusion or order clear.
evaluation.fail_definition: The wording attempts to group the outcomes but conflates their distinct roles or leaves unclear which conclusion or order governs them.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require mentioning every outcome or imply that the outcomes have the same legal or procedural status.

skills.name: State a shared limit relation for distinct pollutants
skills.action: List selected distinct pollutants and state their common relationship to a shared limit once.

applicability.description: When several pollutants are described as subject to one shared permit-limit issue.

context.scope_limits: Does not require listing every pollutant or establish that the pollutants have identical measurements or individual circumstances.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that multiple pollutants share a particular limit issue.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly relates the selected pollutants to the common limit issue while keeping the pollutants distinguishable.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to state a shared limit relation but makes the limit appear to apply to only an unclear subset, or treats distinct pollutants as the same item.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require listing every pollutant or establish that the pollutants have identical measurements or individual circumstances.

skills.name: Keep each ground with its own basis and explanation
skills.action: Present each selected ground with the legal basis and explanatory particulars that the report associates with it.

applicability.description: When a report presents multiple violation grounds, statutory bases, or other distinct allegations with their explanations.

context.scope_limits: Assesses only associations expressed in the report, not their truth against source records. Does not require a particular order, separate blocks, or inclusion of every available ground.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively associates an explanation, supporting particulars, or statutory basis with one or more separately identified grounds.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear which basis and explanation belong to each ground it presents, while retaining distinctions among grounds.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted structure attaches an explanation or basis to the wrong ground, leaves its association ambiguous, or presents distinct grounds as one ground.

extensions.scope_limits: Assesses only associations expressed in the report, not their truth against source records. Does not require a particular order, separate blocks, or inclusion of every available ground.

skills.name: Resolve a forward reference to violation particulars
skills.action: Introduce a selected set of violations with a forward reference and make its corresponding particulars identifiable.

applicability.description: When a report introduces a set of violations and points forward to their particulars.

context.scope_limits: Does not require treating every later explanatory detail as a separate violation or require a forward reference at all.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses a summary or forward-pointing phrase that positively refers to violation particulars stated later.
evaluation.pass_definition: The later material clearly resolves the stated reference to the selected violation particulars.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted forward reference has no clear resolution, or the later material does not make clear which particulars the reference covers.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require treating every later explanatory detail as a separate violation or require a forward reference at all.

skills.name: Relate multiple incidents to one shared allegation
skills.action: Describe selected incidents and state their shared alleged legal consequence with a clear relation between them.

applicability.description: When multiple incidents are alleged to have one shared legal consequence under a cited provision.

context.scope_limits: Does not require grouping incidents, prove the alleged violation, or establish that every incident has identical details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively links two or more incidents to one shared alleged legal consequence.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear that the selected incidents are jointly associated with the same alleged legal consequence.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted shared allegation leaves unclear which incidents it covers, or makes the incidents appear to be separate legal consequences when one shared consequence is asserted.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require grouping incidents, prove the alleged violation, or establish that every incident has identical details.

skills.name: Ineligible: generic framing or labeling
skills.action: Preserve the observation as framing or labeling provenance; do not score the mere presence, wording, or position of a heading or frame.

applicability.description: The observations concern labels, headings, general allegation framing, or a broad regulatory frame without a separately assessable relation among report propositions.

context.scope_limits: Includes category labels, allegation headings, generic direct-allegation framing, and broad frames for following items. Does not cover a clear association of each legal ground with its explanation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: A writer uses a heading, category label, opening frame, or general description to introduce or characterize material.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable as a bank rule; a different supported relational operation may be assessed separately.
evaluation.fail_definition: No reusable report-observable pass/fail boundary is defined here: naming or framing a category alone does not assess a relation among propositions.

extensions.scope_limits: Includes category labels, allegation headings, generic direct-allegation framing, and broad frames for following items. Does not cover a clear association of each legal ground with its explanation.

skills.name: Ineligible: optional collective summary
skills.action: Retain the observation as a summary or compression preference without scoring whether individual categories are enumerated.

applicability.description: When a report uses a collective phrase to summarize multiple recorded violation categories without identifying their individual membership or relations.

context.scope_limits: Does not cover coordination that positively presents distinct categories together and must preserve their distinction.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively substitutes a collective description for individually stated categories.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable as a bank rule; a coherent collective summary or a different selection of details is discretionary.
evaluation.fail_definition: No reliable pass/fail boundary follows from the observation: omitted category details are optional, and the collective wording alone does not express a nontrivial relation among them.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not cover coordination that positively presents distinct categories together and must preserve their distinction.

skills.name: Ineligible: discretionary ordering
skills.action: Preserve the observed ordering preference as provenance, but do not score sequence, opening position, or transition choice by itself.

applicability.description: When multiple topics or allegation blocks are placed in a chosen narrative sequence without a required temporal, causal, priority, or attribution relation.

context.scope_limits: Does not cover ordering needed to keep an explanation attached to its specific allegation; that relation is assessed separately.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report orders two or more issues, grounds, or allegation blocks, or uses transitions to mark their sequence.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable as a bank rule; any coherent order is acceptable absent a specific relationship that must be preserved.
evaluation.fail_definition: No pass/fail boundary is warranted for the chosen order or transition alone where the observation supplies no required logical, temporal, or attribution relation.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not cover ordering needed to keep an explanation attached to its specific allegation; that relation is assessed separately.

skills.name: Ineligible: discretionary detail allocation
skills.action: Retain the detail-allocation observation as provenance without scoring the relative length of explanations.

applicability.description: When one statutory ground receives more or less detail than another without a stated reason that changes their relationship.

context.scope_limits: Does not excuse an attempted but ambiguous association between a ground and its explanation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report varies the amount or length of statutory explanation across grounds.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable as a bank rule; unequal or equal detail is not a failure absent a separate stated relation or obligation.
evaluation.fail_definition: No report-observable failure is established by unequal detail alone; the observation provides no required amount or balance of explanation.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not excuse an attempted but ambiguous association between a ground and its explanation.

skills.name: Relate pollutant to affected medium
skills.action: State the relationship between the identified pollutant and affected medium.

applicability.description: Applies when a report explicitly relates an identified pollutant to an affected environmental medium.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer quantity, extent, or contamination level. Either role may be named in a coherent construction; source-specific wording is not required.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The prose attempts to state which pollutant is associated with, affects, or contaminates which medium; merely naming both is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording makes the pollutant and affected medium, and their association, unambiguous without adding a quantity or contamination level.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted association leaves the pollutant–medium pairing unclear or expresses the roles in a way that can be read as reversed.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer quantity, extent, or contamination level. Either role may be named in a coherent construction; source-specific wording is not required.

skills.name: Coordinate selected substance names in a list
skills.action: Present selected pollutant or chemical names as a readable, unambiguous coordinated list.

applicability.description: Applies when prose intentionally presents at least two selected substances as members of one list.

context.scope_limits: Do not require any particular names, ordering, qualifier, conjunction, or list length beyond two selected items. Omission of other optional substances is not a failure; wording that marks one item as an addition is optional.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The prose positively attempts to coordinate two or more substance names as one list; simply naming multiple substances in separate propositions is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The selected names are clearly presented as members of one coordinated list, with their identities distinguishable.
evaluation.fail_definition: An attempted list makes it unclear which names are members of the list or whether they share the same list-level grammatical role.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require any particular names, ordering, qualifier, conjunction, or list length beyond two selected items. Omission of other optional substances is not a failure; wording that marks one item as an addition is optional.

skills.name: Attach pollutant categories to their violation proposition
skills.action: Place the selected pollutant categories under the violation or exceedance proposition they qualify.

applicability.description: Applies when a report lists pollutant categories as qualifying or specifying a violation or exceedance proposition.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer a violation, count, date range, or pollutant-category correspondence not expressed in the prose. Unselected categories are not required.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The prose attempts to connect a list of pollutant categories to a particular violation or exceedance proposition; merely listing pollutants and mentioning a violation elsewhere is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly attaches the selected pollutant categories to the stated violation or exceedance proposition without implying that the category data independently establish the violation.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted connection leaves unclear which violation or exceedance proposition the categories qualify, or makes the category-to-proposition relationship internally ambiguous.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer a violation, count, date range, or pollutant-category correspondence not expressed in the prose. Unselected categories are not required.

skills.name: Tie listed chemicals to an alleged omission
skills.action: Connect the selected chemical names to the specific omission alleged in the report.

applicability.description: Applies when named chemicals are presented as items allegedly omitted from, or not reported in, a submission or inventory.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer additional chemicals, inventory details, or a finding that the allegation is true. Omission of other optional items is not a failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The prose attempts to state that selected named chemicals are the items alleged to have been omitted or unreported; naming chemicals without connecting them to that alleged omission is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly identifies the selected chemicals as the subject of the omission allegation and preserves that allegation as an allegation.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted relationship leaves unclear which chemicals the omission allegation concerns, or presents the alleged omission as an established finding rather than maintaining its stated allegation status.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer additional chemicals, inventory details, or a finding that the allegation is true. Omission of other optional items is not a failure.

skills.name: Name a substance from its descriptor
skills.action: Use a supplied pollutant or material descriptor to name the substance in prose.

applicability.description: Applies when prose names a pollutant, chemical, or other material, including when its descriptor is shortened, expanded, or divided across source text units.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer an event, release circumstance, quantity, odor, location, applicable action, or required naming convention from the substance field. Cross-unit segmentation and optional descriptor detail do not create separate obligations.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The prose attempts to name a substance or render its descriptor as a reader-facing name; merely discussing an event without naming its material is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: No eligible pass/fail boundary is assigned; a report’s choice of name, qualifier, expansion, or text-unit rendering is not scored as a standalone transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: No eligible pass/fail boundary is assigned: the observations concern substance naming or descriptor rendering alone, which is not an assessable transformation under these criteria.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer an event, release circumstance, quantity, odor, location, applicable action, or required naming convention from the substance field. Cross-unit segmentation and optional descriptor detail do not create separate obligations.

skills.name: Attach an amount to its penalty role
skills.action: When stating a monetary quantity, attach it to the supported penalty or penalty category it measures.

applicability.description: The report positively states a penalty amount and relates that amount to the penalty or a specified penalty category.

context.scope_limits: Does not require including a penalty amount. Does not require a currency style, use of a particular penalty adjective, or coverage of every monetary field.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report gives a monetary quantity and linguistically attaches it to a penalty, penalty type, or penalty outcome.
evaluation.pass_definition: The reader can identify which stated penalty or penalty category the amount quantifies; the amount is not confused with a cost, project, or other monetary measure.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts that attachment but leaves the amount's penalty referent unclear, attaches it to a different category, or merges distinct penalty categories into an unidentified figure.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require including a penalty amount. Does not require a currency style, use of a particular penalty adjective, or coverage of every monetary field.

skills.name: Preserve assessed-penalty status
skills.action: Identify a penalty amount as assessed, imposed, or ordered when that is the status being reported.

applicability.description: The report states a penalty amount as assessed, imposed, or ordered, rather than merely agreed or collected.

context.scope_limits: Does not require reporting assessment where the report chooses another supported monetary fact. Does not treat order issuance as collection.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively characterizes a stated penalty amount as an assessment, imposition, or order.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording identifies the amount as assessed, imposed, or ordered and does not imply that assessment alone means payment was completed.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to report an assessed amount but its wording makes the amount appear collected, merely promised, or otherwise assigns it a conflicting status.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require reporting assessment where the report chooses another supported monetary fact. Does not treat order issuance as collection.

skills.name: Distinguish completed collection from other statuses
skills.action: Use completed-payment or collection wording only for a supported collected penalty amount.

applicability.description: The report positively states that a penalty amount was collected, paid, or paid in full.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a payment date, method, or numeric amount. A future commitment to pay is not completed payment.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report describes a penalty amount or penalty as completed collection or payment, including a comparison supporting a paid-in-full claim.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly presents payment or collection as completed and does not substitute an assessed or still-payable amount for a collected amount.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts a completed-payment claim but states only an assessment or future obligation, or uses wording that makes the collection/payment status unclear or contradictory.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a payment date, method, or numeric amount. A future commitment to pay is not completed payment.

skills.name: Represent an agreed penalty payment as a commitment
skills.action: Frame a supported agreed penalty payment as a commitment by the relevant party, distinct from collection.

applicability.description: The report positively presents a party's agreement or commitment to pay a penalty.

context.scope_limits: A penalty amount alone does not establish an agreement. Does not require a deadline or other unstated terms.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states that a party agreed, consented, or committed to pay a penalty, or presents payment as a term of an agreement.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording identifies the party's agreement or commitment and the penalty payment it concerns, without implying that payment has already occurred.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to express a commitment but conflates it with completed payment or assessment, fails to connect the commitment to the relevant party or penalty, or uses wording that leaves the commitment's status ambiguous.

extensions.scope_limits: A penalty amount alone does not establish an agreement. Does not require a deadline or other unstated terms.

skills.name: Link a required payment to its instrument and obligor
skills.action: State which supported instrument requires which party to pay the penalty.

applicability.description: The report positively states that an order, settlement, or other instrument requires a party to pay a penalty.

context.scope_limits: Does not require describing every term of an instrument. Do not infer an obligation or payment deadline from an amount alone.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report relates a formal instrument to a party's required penalty payment or obligation.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly relates the supported instrument to the party's penalty-payment obligation and does not confuse that obligation with completed payment.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts that relation but obscures which instrument imposes the obligation, which party owes it, or whether the amount is required rather than already collected.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require describing every term of an instrument. Do not infer an obligation or payment deadline from an amount alone.

skills.name: Keep distinct monetary categories distinct
skills.action: Keep separately reported monetary categories or obligations distinguishable when presenting their amounts together.

applicability.description: The report positively distinguishes amounts belonging to separate monetary categories, obligations, or components.

context.scope_limits: Does not require listing every available category or including omitted figures. A single amount does not create a coordination requirement.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report names or describes at least two distinct monetary categories or obligations and relates their amounts or presentation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Each stated amount remains identifiable with its own category or obligation, and no unsupported combined total is implied.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to present the distinct categories but merges them into an ambiguous total, attaches an amount to the wrong category, or makes separate obligations appear to be one.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require listing every available category or including omitted figures. A single amount does not create a coordination requirement.

skills.name: Attach a non-penalty amount to its measure
skills.action: Identify the non-penalty measure quantified by a stated monetary amount.

applicability.description: The report quantifies a non-penalty monetary item, such as a project, cost, or recovery.

context.scope_limits: Does not require mentioning the amount or any particular cost category. Does not authorize treating non-penalty costs as penalties.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report gives an amount and explicitly attaches it to a non-penalty item, cost, project, or recovery.
evaluation.pass_definition: The amount is clearly identified as the value, cost, or recovery of the stated non-penalty item.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts that amount-to-item relation but leaves the quantified item unclear or makes the figure appear to quantify a different monetary category.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require mentioning the amount or any particular cost category. Does not authorize treating non-penalty costs as penalties.

skills.name: Present a supported monetary total
skills.action: Present a supported combined amount as the total for its specific monetary measure.

applicability.description: The report aggregates monetary components into a supported total, particularly a cost-recovery total.

context.scope_limits: Does not require combining amounts or repeating component values. Do not infer payment timing or completion from an award or total.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report presents a combined amount as a total or uses a stated total in place of separate component amounts.
evaluation.pass_definition: The total is clearly attached to the correct monetary measure and is supported as a combined total; it is not confused with a component or a different category.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts an aggregation but the total is not clearly a total of the relevant measure, conflicts with the stated components, or is confused with a payment amount or another category.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require combining amounts or repeating component values. Do not infer payment timing or completion from an award or total.

skills.name: Preserve monetary amount qualifications
skills.action: Preserve a supplied approximation or bound when stating a monetary amount.

applicability.description: The report qualifies a stated monetary amount with a bound or approximation such as 'approximately' or 'at least.'

context.scope_limits: Does not require adding a qualifier when none is supplied.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report states an amount with an explicit qualification of approximation, minimum, or another quantitative bound.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording preserves the stated approximation or bound and does not turn it into an unsupported exact amount, maximum, or different quantity.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts a qualified quantity but removes, contradicts, or reverses the qualifier so that an approximate or minimum amount reads as exact or differently bounded.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require adding a qualifier when none is supplied.

skills.name: Keep coordinated obligations distinguishable
skills.action: When presenting multiple obligations under one instrument, relate them to the instrument while keeping each obligation distinct.

applicability.description: The report coordinates multiple obligations under one instrument.

context.scope_limits: Applies only when the report attempts to present multiple obligations together; one obligation does not create a coordination rule.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly relates one instrument and responsible party to two or more distinct obligations.
evaluation.pass_definition: Each obligation remains recognizable as distinct while its shared instrument and responsible party are clear.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to coordinate the obligations but makes them appear to be one obligation, loses which instrument or party governs them, or implies that one amount includes another.

extensions.scope_limits: Applies only when the report attempts to present multiple obligations together; one obligation does not create a coordination rule.

skills.name: Match each party to its allocated amount
skills.action: When describing a multi-party allocation, associate each party with its own supported amount or obligation.

applicability.description: The report assigns separate monetary remedies or amounts to multiple parties.

context.scope_limits: Does not require reporting multiple parties or allocations where the report chooses not to do so.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states an allocation of obligations or amounts among two or more parties.
evaluation.pass_definition: Each stated party is clearly paired with the corresponding amount or obligation.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts an allocation but leaves unclear which party bears which amount or obligation, or makes a party-specific allocation appear collective or reversed.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require reporting multiple parties or allocations where the report chooses not to do so.

skills.name: Attribute completed penalty payment to its payer
skills.action: Identify the supported payer when stating that a penalty was paid.

applicability.description: The report states who paid a penalty or identifies a participant as the payer, beyond merely naming an amount.

context.scope_limits: A collected-amount field or penalty amount alone does not establish a report's payer attribution. Does not require certification or other optional framing.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively attributes a payment or payment action to a specific party or collective party.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies who paid the penalty and presents the action as completed only when its wording supports that status.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts payer attribution but leaves the payer unclear, assigns the payment to the wrong participant in its own wording, or makes a commitment appear to be completed payment.

extensions.scope_limits: A collected-amount field or penalty amount alone does not establish a report's payer attribution. Does not require certification or other optional framing.

skills.name: Map the stated undertaking to its participant
skills.action: Connect a stated undertaking to the participant who performs or accepts it.

applicability.description: The report identifies a participant as undertaking a monetary action or explicitly attaches an action to a party, without making a completed-payment claim.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a payment commitment unless the report states one; does not infer an actor from an amount field.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively maps a named participant to an undertaking or action role, such as agreeing to perform an action under an instrument.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording makes clear which participant undertakes the stated action and does not attribute the undertaking to an ambiguous or different actor.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts that participant-action mapping but leaves the actor or undertaking unclear, or confuses the undertaking with an action by another participant.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a payment commitment unless the report states one; does not infer an actor from an amount field.

skills.name: Formatting, selection, or standalone outcome wording
skills.action: No eligible transformation is defined: currency styling, optional selection or omission, and naming an outcome alone do not supply a relational pass/fail boundary.

applicability.description: The observation concerns only number or currency rendering, selection or omission of optional monetary facts, or a penalty outcome without a monetary-role relation.

context.scope_limits: Includes rendering choices such as currency symbols, digit grouping, written-out numbers, and optional numeric coverage; it does not excuse a failed monetary-role or status relation when one is attempted.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: the observation does not specify a sufficiently distinct relational transformation to assess.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable; preserve the observation as provenance rather than assessing it as a transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable; formatting preferences, optional inclusion choices, and simple outcome naming are not failures under this bank.

extensions.scope_limits: Includes rendering choices such as currency symbols, digit grouping, written-out numbers, and optional numeric coverage; it does not excuse a failed monetary-role or status relation when one is attempted.

skills.name: Optional monetary coverage
skills.action: No eligible transformation is defined: do not assess optional inclusion, omission, or level of numerical detail as failures.

applicability.description: The observation is about selecting or omitting monetary information without a required relationship among facts.

context.scope_limits: Only selection and coverage are ineligible here. A report that affirmatively combines or misattributes stated monetary categories may be assessed under the relevant relational group.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: optional coverage or omission does not constitute an attempted transformation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable; a different coherent selection of facts is acceptable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable; omission of an optional monetary fact is never a failure.

extensions.scope_limits: Only selection and coverage are ineligible here. A report that affirmatively combines or misattributes stated monetary categories may be assessed under the relevant relational group.

skills.name: Standalone penalty outcome naming
skills.action: No eligible transformation is defined: standalone outcome naming does not create an assessable monetary relation.

applicability.description: The report only names a penalty outcome or disposition and does not attempt an amount, status, or other monetary relation.

context.scope_limits: If the report goes on to characterize an amount as assessed, collected, agreed, or required, assess that attempted relation under the corresponding eligible group.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: a topic mention or standalone outcome label does not positively attempt a relational transformation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable; simple naming of an outcome is not an eligible transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable; no amount or monetary-role relation is being assessed.

extensions.scope_limits: If the report goes on to characterize an amount as assessed, collected, agreed, or required, assess that attempted relation under the corresponding eligible group.

skills.name: Link a resolution to its subject matter
skills.action: State which reported matter, conduct, or violations a settlement or order resolves or addresses.

applicability.description: When a report presents a resolution as addressing a specified matter, conduct, or violations.

context.scope_limits: Do not require optional details about the matter. Do not convert allegations into findings or infer admissions.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report names a resolution and a matter, conduct, or violations, and positively states that the resolution addresses or settles them.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the matter, conduct, or violations addressed by the resolution without implying an unsupported adjudication or admission.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts this link, but the reader cannot tell which matter or conduct the resolution addresses, or the clauses leave their relationship unstated.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require optional details about the matter. Do not convert allegations into findings or infer admissions.

skills.name: Relate allegations or claims to a resolution
skills.action: Relate allegations or claims to the resolution they concern, keeping allegation status distinct from a finding.

applicability.description: When alleged conduct or claims are related to a settlement or resolution.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a resolution to admit, establish, or individually dispose of each allegation or claim.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively links an allegation or claim to a resolution, settlement, or its terms.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly states that the resolution concerns the identified allegations or claims while preserving their stated allegation or claim status.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the link but leaves unclear whether the resolution concerns the allegations or claims, or presents them as findings or admissions without making that status clear.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a resolution to admit, establish, or individually dispose of each allegation or claim.

skills.name: Link an enforcement response to alleged conduct
skills.action: State the agency's identified response in relation to the alleged conduct.

applicability.description: When a report moves from alleged conduct to an agency response.

context.scope_limits: This concerns an allegation-to-response relation, not the relation between a final resolution and its subject or monetary terms.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively presents an enforcement response as a response to identified alleged conduct.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the agency response and the alleged conduct to which it responds, without presenting the allegation as an adjudicated finding.
evaluation.fail_definition: The response and allegation are both mentioned, but the attempted response relationship is unclear, or the report conflates an allegation with a finding.

extensions.scope_limits: This concerns an allegation-to-response relation, not the relation between a final resolution and its subject or monetary terms.

skills.name: Associate an enforcement event with a violation
skills.action: Connect an enforcement event to the violation it is reported as addressing or citing.

applicability.description: When a report relates an enforcement event, such as a warning, to a cited violation.

context.scope_limits: A connection alone does not establish that the violation caused the action or was adjudicated.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively connects an enforcement event to a violation it addresses or cites.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the violation associated with the enforcement event without claiming a causal rationale or adjudicated finding unless it says so.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the connection, but it is unclear which violation the event concerns or whether the two are related.

extensions.scope_limits: A connection alone does not establish that the violation caused the action or was adjudicated.

skills.name: State the reported grounds for an enforcement action
skills.action: Connect an enforcement action to the violation, finding, or observation expressly presented as its basis.

applicability.description: When a report states the grounds, reason, or findings supporting an enforcement action.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer motive, causation, factual validation, or adjudication beyond the report's expressed rationale.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively presents a violation, stated finding, or observation as grounds for, or a reason behind, an enforcement action.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the stated basis for the action and preserves the status of that basis as expressed in the report.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to give grounds for the action but leaves the basis unclear, or collapses an allegation, observation, or finding into another status.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer motive, causation, factual validation, or adjudication beyond the report's expressed rationale.

skills.name: Attribute a consequence to the described matter
skills.action: Use an unambiguous reference when attributing a reported consequence to a described matter.

applicability.description: When a report attributes a later consequence to a previously described matter.

context.scope_limits: Assess the attribution expressed in the report; do not require independent proof of causation or add unstated consequences.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively attributes a consequence, such as a penalty or compliance outcome, to a preceding matter.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear which previously described matter the consequence is attributed to.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to attribute the consequence, but its reference to the matter is ambiguous or the stated attribution is unclear.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess the attribution expressed in the report; do not require independent proof of causation or add unstated consequences.

skills.name: Link a penalty obligation to a resolution
skills.action: Relate an assessed, agreed, or imposed penalty to the resolution under which it is reported.

applicability.description: When a report connects an assessed, agreed, or imposed penalty to a resolution.

context.scope_limits: Do not describe an amount as paid or collected unless the report says payment occurred. Do not require a monetary amount when the report does not provide one.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively links a penalty obligation or stated monetary consequence to an agreement, order, or resolution.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly connects the penalty obligation or stated monetary consequence to the identified resolution while retaining the monetary status it expresses.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the link but leaves unclear which resolution the penalty belongs to, or conflates an assessed or agreed amount with a payment already collected.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not describe an amount as paid or collected unless the report says payment occurred. Do not require a monetary amount when the report does not provide one.

skills.name: Link a completed penalty payment to a resolution
skills.action: State a reported completed penalty payment and connect it to the settlement or resolution it serves.

applicability.description: When a report states that a penalty was paid or collected as part of a settlement or resolution.

context.scope_limits: Do not require a payment claim where the report describes only a prospective or agreed amount. Do not imply that payment alone constitutes the entire settlement.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that a penalty was paid or collected and links that payment to a settlement or resolution.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly presents the amount as paid or collected, rather than merely assessed or due, and identifies the related settlement or resolution.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts this link but leaves unclear which resolution the payment serves, or uses wording that confuses payment made with an amount merely assessed, agreed, or due.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require a payment claim where the report describes only a prospective or agreed amount. Do not imply that payment alone constitutes the entire settlement.

skills.name: Relate a remedy to its resolution
skills.action: State how a reported remedy or corrective measure relates to the formal resolution.

applicability.description: When a report relates a remedy, corrective response, or project to a formal resolution.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer that a remedy is a condition of a penalty, that it caused an outcome, or that it was completed unless the report says so. Penalty-only links belong to the monetary groups.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that a remedy, corrective response, compliance measure, or project belongs to or is required under a resolution.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly connects the stated remedy to the resolution and preserves whether it is required, agreed, or completed as expressed.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the relationship but leaves unclear which resolution the remedy belongs to, or conflates a required action with one already completed.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer that a remedy is a condition of a penalty, that it caused an outcome, or that it was completed unless the report says so. Penalty-only links belong to the monetary groups.

skills.name: Relate an enforcement instrument to its action
skills.action: Name the relevant enforcement instrument and relate it to the action it concerns.

applicability.description: When a report connects a named enforcement instrument to the action it initiates, resolves, or concludes.

context.scope_limits: An instrument is not the same as a legal authority or an instrument's issuer. Do not infer procedural effect beyond the report's wording.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively relates a formal order or agreement to an enforcement action it concerns.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the action associated with the instrument and states its expressed procedural relation to that action.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the instrument-to-action relationship but leaves unclear which action the instrument concerns or what role the instrument has in it.

extensions.scope_limits: An instrument is not the same as a legal authority or an instrument's issuer. Do not infer procedural effect beyond the report's wording.

skills.name: Present an instrument as the matter's disposition
skills.action: Describe an enforcement instrument as resolving the associated matter when the report presents it as the disposition.

applicability.description: When a report presents an order or enforcement instrument as resolving or closing a case or matter.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer a particular legal mechanism, closure date, or resolution effect for every order.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively characterizes an order or instrument as the event that resolves, concludes, or closes a matter.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly states the instrument's expressed role in resolving, concluding, or closing the identified matter.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to characterize the instrument as resolving the matter but leaves unclear whether it is the resolution event or merely associated with the case.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer a particular legal mechanism, closure date, or resolution effect for every order.

skills.name: Relate a participant's commitment to an order
skills.action: Describe a party's reported commitment in relation to the applicable order or enforcement outcome.

applicability.description: When a report connects a participant's commitment to a recorded order or enforcement outcome.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer the precise terms, timing, or legal effect of the commitment from the existence of an order.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that a participant made or entered into a commitment in relation to an identified order or outcome.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the participant and relates the stated commitment to the applicable order without implying unsupported agreement wording or sequence.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the commitment-to-order link but leaves unclear who made the commitment or which order it relates to.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer the precise terms, timing, or legal effect of the commitment from the existence of an order.

skills.name: Attach a date to the settlement event
skills.action: State the date as the date on which the settlement occurred.

applicability.description: When a report gives a date for a settlement event.

context.scope_limits: Do not substitute a final-order, filing, payment, or closure date for a settlement date. Do not require a date when none is reported.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively attaches a date to the event of settling or reaching a settlement.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report unambiguously assigns the date to the settlement event.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to date the settlement but leaves unclear whether the date belongs to the settlement event or to another event.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not substitute a final-order, filing, payment, or closure date for a settlement date. Do not require a date when none is reported.

skills.name: Distinguish the participants' settlement roles
skills.action: Describe the identified party as settling with the identified counterpart.

applicability.description: When a report identifies the participants in a settlement and their respective roles.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer a participant's role from a lead field alone, or confuse the counterpart with an authority, issuer, or enforcement instrument.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states which participant settled with which other participant.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes the settling party and the other settlement participant unambiguous.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to identify the settlement participants but leaves unclear which one is settling and which one is the counterpart.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer a participant's role from a lead field alone, or confuse the counterpart with an authority, issuer, or enforcement instrument.

skills.name: Optional lexical framing and descriptor choices
skills.action: Preserve the observation as provenance for optional lexicalization or framing, but do not turn it into a writing requirement.

applicability.description: These observations concern lexical labels, category modifiers, or discretionary framing rather than a required relational operation.

context.scope_limits: Covers naming an outcome milestone, rendering an enforcement type as a settlement label, selecting a relief-category modifier, characterizing a case by its relief type, and choosing an opening frame. Simple naming and optional opening positions have no required pass/fail boundary.

evaluation.attempt_definition: Not applicable: these observations do not define an eligible, independently assessable transformation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: No pass/fail judgment should be made under this group; requiring these labels, phrases, or opening choices would impose an ineligible preference.

extensions.scope_limits: Covers naming an outcome milestone, rendering an enforcement type as a settlement label, selecting a relief-category modifier, characterizing a case by its relief type, and choosing an opening frame. Simple naming and optional opening positions have no required pass/fail boundary.

skills.name: Attribute required conduct to an order
skills.action: State who an order requires to do what, at the level of detail supported by the report.

applicability.description: When a report states that an order imposes a compliance requirement on a party.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer specific terms, deadlines, monitoring details, or completed compliance. Site details are required only when the text attempts to state where the required conduct applies.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively attributes required conduct to an order and identifies, explicitly or by clear context, the party bound or the conduct required.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly expresses the order as requiring or directing the party to perform the stated conduct, without implying that the requirement has already been fulfilled.
evaluation.fail_definition: The text attempts to describe the order's operative requirement but leaves unclear whether the conduct is required by the order, who is bound, or what conduct is required; merely mentioning the order and conduct does not pass.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer specific terms, deadlines, monitoring details, or completed compliance. Site details are required only when the text attempts to state where the required conduct applies.

skills.name: Distinguish an order's intended effect from an achieved outcome
skills.action: Describe an order's stated compliance effect as intended unless the report separately establishes achievement.

applicability.description: When a report explains an order's stated objective or intended compliance effect.

context.scope_limits: Applies to stated objectives or intended effects, not to every operative requirement or later outcome.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively links an order to an intended compliance effect or objective.
evaluation.pass_definition: The text attributes the effect to the order as its purpose or intended result, without claiming that compliance or the result occurred.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted link makes the effect appear achieved, or leaves unclear whether it is an objective of the order rather than a subsequent outcome.

extensions.scope_limits: Applies to stated objectives or intended effects, not to every operative requirement or later outcome.

skills.name: Link compliance conduct to its legal authority
skills.action: Connect a compliance requirement to its stated legal or regulatory framework.

applicability.description: When the report links required conduct or a compliance objective to a named law, regulation, permit, or regulatory framework.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer a specific provision or exact legal match from a broad framework description. Legal authority is distinct from the issuer of an order or other instrument.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively connects the compliance requirement or objective to a named legal or regulatory authority.
evaluation.pass_definition: The text clearly identifies the authority as the framework governing or supporting the stated compliance requirement or objective.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted connection misattributes the authority, leaves unclear which requirement it governs, or presents the authority as the issuer of an enforcement instrument.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer a specific provision or exact legal match from a broad framework description. Legal authority is distinct from the issuer of an order or other instrument.

skills.name: Attribute obligations to an agreement
skills.action: State who agreed to which obligations and, when attempted, identify the agreement as their source.

applicability.description: When a report states that a party agreed to obligations as part of a settlement or agreement.

context.scope_limits: Do not require naming every party or repeating an instrument already made clear in context. Do not imply that agreed work is completed.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively attributes an undertaking or obligation to a party's agreement or to terms of a settlement instrument.
evaluation.pass_definition: The text clearly states that the identified party agreed to the obligations, or that they are terms of the identified agreement, without converting agreement into completed performance.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted attribution obscures whether the party agreed, who made the agreement, or whether the obligations are terms of that agreement; describing the same conduct only as an order-imposed duty does not pass.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require naming every party or repeating an instrument already made clear in context. Do not imply that agreed work is completed.

skills.name: Attribute required work to a settling party
skills.action: State that the settling party is required to perform the supported compliance work.

applicability.description: When a settlement report states that a settling party must perform specified compliance work.

context.scope_limits: Do not narrow broad or alternative work categories to a single specific phase or task unless supported.
