evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively maps a settling party to work required under the settlement or case resolution.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the settling party as responsible for the stated required work, preserving any supported range or alternative in the work description.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted mapping makes unclear which party must perform the work or whether the work is a settlement requirement rather than an unrelated action.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not narrow broad or alternative work categories to a single specific phase or task unless supported.

skills.name: Coordinate distinct requirements without changing their structure
skills.action: Coordinate multiple requirements while preserving their distinct scope and any internal alternatives.

applicability.description: When a report describes multiple distinct requirements or obligations together.

context.scope_limits: A list of one item does not qualify. Do not add a requirement merely to create a list or imply a relationship not stated in the report.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively coordinates two or more distinct requirements as separate items, or explicitly preserves an alternative within a requirement.
evaluation.pass_definition: Each coordinated requirement remains identifiable as a separate item, and any stated alternatives remain alternatives.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted coordination makes separate requirements appear to be one action, turns alternatives into cumulative duties, or otherwise changes which items are required.

extensions.scope_limits: A list of one item does not qualify. Do not add a requirement merely to create a list or imply a relationship not stated in the report.

skills.name: Keep monetary consequences distinct from compliance measures
skills.action: Present a monetary consequence and a compliance obligation as distinct kinds of settlement terms.

applicability.description: When a report mentions both a monetary consequence and a nonmonetary compliance obligation.

context.scope_limits: Do not require both items to be included when the writer has not chosen to report both; do not infer a measure or amount.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively presents both a monetary amount or penalty and a compliance measure or commitment in the same account.
evaluation.pass_definition: The text makes clear which item is the monetary consequence and which is the required or committed compliance measure.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted presentation conflates the monetary consequence with the compliance measure, or makes the amount appear to be the measure or vice versa.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require both items to be included when the writer has not chosen to report both; do not infer a measure or amount.

skills.name: Link monitoring or sampling to its reported results
skills.action: Link required monitoring or sampling with the submission of its results.

applicability.description: When required monitoring or sampling and submission of its results are both described.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer monitoring protocols, reporting destinations, schedules, or frequencies.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively links monitoring or sampling to submission or reporting of the resulting findings.
evaluation.pass_definition: The text makes clear that the results submitted or reported are results of the stated monitoring or sampling.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted link leaves unclear what is being reported, or implies that the submission is unrelated to or precedes the monitoring or sampling.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer monitoring protocols, reporting destinations, schedules, or frequencies.

skills.name: Retain the condition on a notification duty
skills.action: State a notification duty together with its supplied condition.

applicability.description: When a notification duty is stated to apply only under a supplied condition.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer the triggering condition, timing, or schedule from unrelated dates or broad action categories.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively states both a notification obligation and a condition governing when that obligation applies.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly states the notification obligation and the condition that triggers or governs it.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted statement omits or misattaches the condition, making the notification appear unconditional or triggered under a different circumstance.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer the triggering condition, timing, or schedule from unrelated dates or broad action categories.

skills.name: Frame a possible consequence as conditional on future noncompliance
skills.action: Describe a possible future consequence as contingent on failure to meet the stated requirement.

applicability.description: When describing a possible consequence contingent on future noncompliance.

context.scope_limits: Do not imply that a future failure occurred or that the consequence was imposed.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively links a possible consequence to a future failure to meet a stated requirement.
evaluation.pass_definition: The text presents the consequence as possible and conditional on future failure to comply with the relevant requirement.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted statement presents the possible consequence as already imposed or certain, or fails to make its dependence on future noncompliance clear.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not imply that a future failure occurred or that the consequence was imposed.

skills.name: Distinguish corrective remedies from continuing duties
skills.action: State corrective duties separately from obligations that continue.

applicability.description: When the report distinguishes a corrective remedy from a separate continuing duty.

context.scope_limits: Apply only when the report distinguishes both kinds of duty; do not infer exact terms from a general action category.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively describes both a corrective requirement and a continuing obligation as separate duties.
evaluation.pass_definition: The text preserves the distinction between the corrective action and the separately continuing obligation.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted description merges the corrective remedy with the continuing duty or makes one appear to replace the other.

extensions.scope_limits: Apply only when the report distinguishes both kinds of duty; do not infer exact terms from a general action category.

skills.name: Resolve a reference to the order supplying obligations
skills.action: Use a clear reference to an established order when attributing its obligations.

applicability.description: When a later statement refers back to an already introduced enforcement order as the source of obligations.

context.scope_limits: This operation resolves the instrument reference only; it does not independently establish the details or deadline of an obligation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively uses a reference to a previously identified order to attribute obligations to it.
evaluation.pass_definition: The reference unambiguously identifies the previously introduced order as the source of the stated obligations.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted reference has more than one plausible antecedent or makes it unclear which instrument supplies the obligations.

extensions.scope_limits: This operation resolves the instrument reference only; it does not independently establish the details or deadline of an obligation.

skills.name: Link restricted conduct to its stated purpose
skills.action: Connect a restriction on conduct to its stated purpose or effect.

applicability.description: When a report describes restricted conduct and states the purpose or effect of that restriction.

context.scope_limits: Use only the conduct and purpose supported by the report; listing conduct alone does not attempt this relation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively links specified conduct or a restriction on it to a stated purpose or effect.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly associates the stated purpose or effect with the relevant restriction or conduct without implying achievement unless reported.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted link leaves unclear which purpose or effect belongs to the conduct, or changes the stated purpose into an outcome already achieved.

extensions.scope_limits: Use only the conduct and purpose supported by the report; listing conduct alone does not attempt this relation.

skills.name: Optional grouping without a specified relation
skills.action: The observation concerns a stylistic preference to group related requirements, not a distinct required transformation.

applicability.description: When two or more related activities are optionally grouped, but the report does not specify a relation between them beyond both being requirements.

context.scope_limits: Preserve as provenance for an optional grouping preference; do not enforce grouping or infer a relationship among activities.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively groups multiple activities under a shared phrase without expressing a more specific relationship.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: no assessable pass criterion is supported.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: grouping or omitting such optional grouping is not a report-observable failure under this observation.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserve as provenance for an optional grouping preference; do not enforce grouping or infer a relationship among activities.

skills.name: Arbitrary sentence ordering preference
skills.action: The observation prescribes a sentence sequence without a supported logical, temporal, or attribution relation.

applicability.description: When a witness prefers a particular sentence sequence without a stated logical or temporal relationship.

context.scope_limits: Preserve the sentence-order preference as provenance; do not enforce a preferred order of work, payment, or location details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively presents multiple obligations in some sequence.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: no assessable pass criterion is supported.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: sentence order alone does not establish a report-observable failure here.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserve the sentence-order preference as provenance; do not enforce a preferred order of work, payment, or location details.

skills.name: Action naming and detail preferences
skills.action: The observation prefers a particular action label, activity list, or level of operational detail.

applicability.description: When the observation asks only for naming or lexicalizing an action, descriptor, activity, program, or scope detail.

context.scope_limits: Preserve the source observations, including action-category examples; do not require specific verbs, lists, frequencies, label text, or other literal details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively names or describes an action or activity without attempting a distinct obligation, attribution, condition, or other relation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: simple action naming or optional detail selection has no independent relation-based pass boundary here.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: unsupported or absent optional action naming is not a transformation failure.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserve the source observations, including action-category examples; do not require specific verbs, lists, frequencies, label text, or other literal details.

skills.name: Optional detail compression
skills.action: The observation concerns discretionary compression or level of detail rather than a required relational transformation.

applicability.description: When a witness prefers compressing, generalizing, or omitting detail without a stated relation that must be preserved.

context.scope_limits: Preserve the compression preference as provenance; do not require omission, generalization, or inclusion of optional details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The text positively summarizes or compresses a permit, requirement, or agreement term.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: no assessable pass criterion is supported.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: a different coherent level of detail or an optional omission is not a failure.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserve the compression preference as provenance; do not require omission, generalization, or inclusion of optional details.

skills.name: Map amounts to distinct monetary remedies
skills.action: When reporting multiple monetary remedies, pair each stated amount with the remedy it quantifies.

applicability.description: When a report elects to state multiple monetary remedies or monetary components and their amounts.

context.scope_limits: Assess only the report’s expressed amount-to-remedy mapping. Do not require omitted remedies or amounts, or enforce TRAIN values.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report names at least two monetary remedy categories or components and attempts to associate amounts with them.
evaluation.pass_definition: Each stated amount is unambiguously associated with its corresponding named monetary remedy.
evaluation.fail_definition: An amount is left unattached or the wording makes it unclear which named monetary remedy it belongs to, or conflates distinct monetary roles.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only the report’s expressed amount-to-remedy mapping. Do not require omitted remedies or amounts, or enforce TRAIN values.

skills.name: Link a remedial action to its affected items
skills.action: When supported and selected for reporting, state which items a remedial action affects.

applicability.description: When a report describes a labeling or other remedial action and identifies items or entities affected by it.

context.scope_limits: This tests the expressed action-to-object relation, not whether omitted items should have been reported or whether the report’s account matches hidden input.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts to say that a remedial action applies to, changes, or otherwise affects a specified item or class of items.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear which stated items or class of items the remedial action affects.
evaluation.fail_definition: The action and items are mentioned but the wording leaves their affected-object relationship unclear, or assigns the relationship ambiguously.

extensions.scope_limits: This tests the expressed action-to-object relation, not whether omitted items should have been reported or whether the report’s account matches hidden input.

skills.name: Coordinate outcomes while keeping them distinct
skills.action: Present selected outcomes as components of the same resolution while preserving their distinct identities.

applicability.description: When a report elects to present two or more distinct remedial or settlement outcomes as parts of one resolution or enforcement action.

context.scope_limits: Do not require every outcome, a single sentence, or any particular ordering. Mere mention of multiple outcomes without an attempted shared relationship is outside this rule.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively presents at least two distinct outcomes as coordinated components of the same settlement, order, or enforcement action.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes the shared resolution or action relationship clear while leaving each stated outcome identifiable.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted coordination makes it unclear whether the outcomes belong to the same resolution, or merges them so their distinct substance or roles cannot be distinguished.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require every outcome, a single sentence, or any particular ordering. Mere mention of multiple outcomes without an attempted shared relationship is outside this rule.

skills.name: Map the responsible party to a required action
skills.action: State who is required to carry out the selected remedial action.

applicability.description: When a report elects to state that a party is required to perform a specified remedial action.

context.scope_limits: Do not infer that the requirement was completed or that every violation has a corresponding remedy. Omission of optional action details is not a failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states an obligation and attempts to identify both the party required to act and the action required.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly connects the stated party with the specified action as an obligation.
evaluation.fail_definition: The wording leaves unclear which party must perform which action, or presents the action as required without a clear responsible party when one is named.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not infer that the requirement was completed or that every violation has a corresponding remedy. Omission of optional action details is not a failure.

skills.name: Distinguish completed action from required action
skills.action: Use wording that distinguishes a completed compliance action from an obligation or commitment.

applicability.description: When a report elects to describe a complying action as conduct that has already occurred.

context.scope_limits: Actor identification is optional unless the report attempts to identify an actor; do not require this fact to be included or enforce TRAIN facts.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively describes a specified remedial or compliance action as completed conduct, rather than merely as a requirement or future plan.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly presents the selected action as completed conduct.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted description leaves completion unclear or presents only an obligation, intention, or future action as though that established completion.

extensions.scope_limits: Actor identification is optional unless the report attempts to identify an actor; do not require this fact to be included or enforce TRAIN facts.

skills.name: Link a remedial action to its stated purpose
skills.action: When selected for reporting, connect a remedial action to the violation or compliance purpose it addresses.

applicability.description: When a report elects to explain the purpose of a remedial or compliance action in relation to a violation, compliance goal, or affected system.

context.scope_limits: Do not require any particular violation, legal description, purpose, or affected system. Do not treat omitted details as failures or enforce hidden input truth.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states why an action is taken or what violation, compliance goal, or system it addresses.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly expresses the selected action as addressing the stated violation or serving the stated compliance purpose.
evaluation.fail_definition: The action and the stated violation, goal, or system are merely juxtaposed, or the attempted purpose relationship is ambiguous or contradictory.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require any particular violation, legal description, purpose, or affected system. Do not treat omitted details as failures or enforce hidden input truth.

skills.name: Resolve references to an enforcement action
skills.action: After introducing an enforcement action, refer back to it with an unambiguous reference.

applicability.description: When a report refers to an agreement or action by reference to an enforcement action introduced in the report.

context.scope_limits: This assesses reference clarity only; it does not require a purpose statement or any specific agreement content.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively uses a subsequent reference to connect an agreement or action to a previously introduced enforcement action.
evaluation.pass_definition: The subsequent reference has a clear, unambiguous antecedent identifying the intended enforcement action.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted reference could reasonably identify more than one action or has no clear antecedent, leaving the referent uncertain.

extensions.scope_limits: This assesses reference clarity only; it does not require a purpose statement or any specific agreement content.

skills.name: Action naming or code lexicalization
skills.action: Render a coded or structured action as a concise action phrase.

applicability.description: When a report turns a structured or coded action category into prose, without attempting a further relationship such as actor, target, purpose, obligation, or completion.

context.scope_limits: Preserve these observations, but do not score vocabulary choice or whether a selected action component is included. A separately attempted relation may be assessed under its own rule.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report attempts only to name or paraphrase a recorded action category in prose.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: action naming or code expansion alone has no eligible pass/fail boundary under this bank.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserve these observations, but do not score vocabulary choice or whether a selected action component is included. A separately attempted relation may be assessed under its own rule.

skills.name: Optional concluding placement and coverage
skills.action: A report may conclude with selected penalty and corrective-action information.

applicability.description: When a report gives a concluding summary of a resolution and elects to mention a penalty and corrective commitment or action.

context.scope_limits: Do not score opening or concluding position, or omission of optional facts. Any independently attempted relationship among the facts can be assessed under its own rule.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report elects to place selected resolution facts in a concluding summary.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: conclusion placement and optional fact selection do not establish a structural pass/fail boundary.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not score opening or concluding position, or omission of optional facts. Any independently attempted relationship among the facts can be assessed under its own rule.

skills.name: Distinguish a project obligation from a penalty
skills.action: When a project is additional to a penalty, state that relationship explicitly.

applicability.description: A report presents a project obligation or expenditure alongside a penalty.

context.scope_limits: Does not require a particular connective or sentence order, and does not require a report to mention a project or penalty.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively describes the project in relation to a penalty, such as saying it is additional to or separate from the penalty.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly presents the project as an additional form of relief, distinct from the penalty.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted relation is unclear or makes the project appear to be part of, or interchangeable with, the penalty rather than additional relief.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require a particular connective or sentence order, and does not require a report to mention a project or penalty.

skills.name: Pair each recipient with its allocation
skills.action: For a recipient-specific project allocation, make the recipient-to-amount pairing explicit.

applicability.description: A report states amounts assigned to one or more named recipients, including a single funding recipient.

context.scope_limits: Does not require an allocation list, an order, or any particular recipients or amounts. A project-wide total that is not presented as recipient-specific is outside this rule; it does not establish payment or completion.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively associates a stated amount with a recipient as an allocation or funding amount.
evaluation.pass_definition: Each reported recipient-specific amount is unambiguously linked to its recipient, including when the linked details continue across text units.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to give recipient-specific amounts but leaves a recipient-to-amount pairing unclear, assigns an amount ambiguously, or separates the details without a recoverable link.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require an allocation list, an order, or any particular recipients or amounts. A project-wide total that is not presented as recipient-specific is outside this rule; it does not establish payment or completion.

skills.name: Identify the responsible party and required project
skills.action: Map the responsible party to the project obligation in the report's wording.

applicability.description: A report describes a project obligation with a responsible party and a required project or activity.

context.scope_limits: Does not require optional beneficiaries, project outcomes, or details absent from the report. Assess only the relation expressed, not whether it matches unprovided source facts.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states who is responsible for carrying out or funding a required project or activity.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report's wording clearly identifies the responsible party and the project or activity that party is required to undertake or fund.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to state the responsibility relation but leaves unclear who must do or fund what, or assigns the obligation to the wrong participant in its own wording.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require optional beneficiaries, project outcomes, or details absent from the report. Assess only the relation expressed, not whether it matches unprovided source facts.

skills.name: Preserve the minimum-amount qualification
skills.action: When stating a project spending threshold, distinguish a minimum from an exact total and identify what it applies to.

applicability.description: A report states a project expenditure as a threshold or minimum.

context.scope_limits: Applies only when the report attempts a threshold claim. It does not require stating a project amount or establish the actual final expenditure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively qualifies a project amount as a minimum, threshold, or amount that must be spent, and links it to the project or activity.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly identifies the amount as a minimum or threshold and links it to the relevant project or activity.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to state a minimum but presents the amount as an exact total, leaves the threshold qualification unclear, or fails to make clear which project or activity the threshold concerns.

extensions.scope_limits: Applies only when the report attempts a threshold claim. It does not require stating a project amount or establish the actual final expenditure.

skills.name: Link beneficiaries to the project activity
skills.action: Connect each reported beneficiary or recipient to the project activity that serves or provides for them.

applicability.description: A report links project beneficiaries or recipients to the activity they benefit from or receive.

context.scope_limits: Does not require naming every beneficiary, enumerating all project items, or reproducing optional project details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively names a beneficiary or recipient and describes the project activity as serving, benefiting, or providing something to that participant.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes the beneficiary-to-activity or recipient-to-activity relation clear for the participants it chooses to mention.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts that link but leaves unclear which participant benefits from or receives the described activity, or conflates distinct beneficiaries in a way that obscures the relation.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require naming every beneficiary, enumerating all project items, or reproducing optional project details.

skills.name: Link project activity to intended purpose
skills.action: State how the project activity is intended to advance its stated purpose.

applicability.description: A report describes a project's purpose and the activity intended to achieve it.

context.scope_limits: Does not require stating a purpose or outcome. Do not infer an outcome, pollutant, or other detail not expressed in the report.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively links a project activity to a purpose or intended environmental effect.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly connects the described project activity to its purpose and presents that purpose as intended rather than as a measured result unless it separately states an outcome.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the purpose-to-activity link but leaves unclear which activity serves the stated purpose, or wording conflates an intended purpose with an achieved outcome.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require stating a purpose or outcome. Do not infer an outcome, pollutant, or other detail not expressed in the report.

skills.name: Preserve the direction of equipment replacement
skills.action: Describe replacement requirements by distinguishing the equipment being replaced from its replacement.

applicability.description: A report summarizes an equipment-replacement requirement.

context.scope_limits: Does not require model names, specifications, timing, or other optional details unless the report itself attempts to state them.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively describes replacing existing equipment with replacement equipment.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording clearly distinguishes the existing equipment from the replacement equipment and states that the former is to be replaced by the latter.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the replacement relation but reverses or obscures which equipment is replaced and which is the replacement, or collapses a stated distinction between them.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require model names, specifications, timing, or other optional details unless the report itself attempts to state them.

skills.name: Optional project-summary coverage
skills.action: No mandatory transformation. A report may summarize, aggregate, or omit secondary project details while remaining coherent.

applicability.description: A report opts to summarize a detailed project, use a broad category, or omit some project particulars.

context.scope_limits: Includes observed choices to summarize project purpose, action, recipients, amount, or inventory at varying levels of detail. Do not treat omission of any selected fact or combination of facts as failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: No assessable attempt is required: these observations concern selected detail, compression, generalization, or coverage rather than a required relation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable as a checklist rule; the chosen level of project detail is discretionary.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable. Omitting or compressing optional project details is not a failure, and a different coherent selection is acceptable.

extensions.scope_limits: Includes observed choices to summarize project purpose, action, recipients, amount, or inventory at varying levels of detail. Do not treat omission of any selected fact or combination of facts as failure.

skills.name: Optional project naming and specificity
skills.action: No mandatory transformation. Use a supported specific or general project description as appropriate to the report.

applicability.description: A report chooses how specifically to name a project or whether to use a category-level description.

context.scope_limits: Simple entity naming, code expansion, category lexicalization, and generic reference are ineligible without an independently attempted relation or qualification.

evaluation.attempt_definition: No assessable attempt is required: these observations concern project naming, category choice, code lexicalization, or generic reference alone.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable as a checklist rule; naming and specificity choices alone do not establish an assessable transformation.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable. A different supported label or level of specificity is not a failure.

extensions.scope_limits: Simple entity naming, code expansion, category lexicalization, and generic reference are ineligible without an independently attempted relation or qualification.

skills.name: Relate a legal basis to the conduct it governs
skills.action: Connect a regulatory category, permit requirement, or statute to the specific conduct or allegation it concerns.

applicability.description: A report connects a regulatory category, permit requirement, or statute to described conduct or an alleged violation.

context.scope_limits: Assesses the expressed legal-basis-to-conduct relation, not whether the source facts make it legally correct. Does not require adding a location or other case details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states that a named or described legal requirement governs, covers, or is the basis for particular conduct or an allegation; merely mentioning both is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear which described conduct or allegation is governed by, or alleged to violate, the identified requirement, while preserving any stated allegation status.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the connection but leaves unclear which conduct the requirement applies to, or presents the requirement as a basis for a different referent. Where the report describes an allegation, recasting it as an established finding also fails.

extensions.scope_limits: Assesses the expressed legal-basis-to-conduct relation, not whether the source facts make it legally correct. Does not require adding a location or other case details.

skills.name: Distinguish an action’s effective date from its event date
skills.action: State a distinct effective date after summarizing the action, preserving its temporal role.

applicability.description: A report summary presents an action and a distinct date on which that action takes effect.

context.scope_limits: Applies only when an effective date is represented as distinct from the action’s occurrence or issuance date; does not require a date when none is reported.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report explicitly presents a date as the effective date of the action; a date mention without an expressed effective-date role is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly identifies the date as when the action takes effect, distinguishes it from any event or issuance date, and places it after the action summary when both are presented.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to state an effective date but leaves its referent unclear or conflates it with the date the action occurred.

extensions.scope_limits: Applies only when an effective date is represented as distinct from the action’s occurrence or issuance date; does not require a date when none is reported.

skills.name: Coordinate monetary and conduct obligations without conflating them
skills.action: Present related monetary and conduct obligations together while preserving their distinct roles.

applicability.description: A report presents both a monetary obligation and one or more conduct obligations as parts of an enforcement outcome.

context.scope_limits: Does not require combining obligations into one sentence or mentioning every available obligation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively coordinates a monetary obligation with conduct restrictions or requirements as distinct obligations; mentioning only one category is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report presents both obligation types in a connected account while making clear which is monetary and which concerns conduct.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to present both categories but blurs their roles, making a conduct obligation appear to be the monetary obligation or vice versa.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require combining obligations into one sentence or mentioning every available obligation.

skills.name: Preserve qualification when explaining an apparent compliance conclusion
skills.action: State an apparent compliance conclusion, then identify the related provision and explain the violation while preserving the conclusion’s qualification.

applicability.description: A report expresses an apparent compliance consequence and relates it to a legal provision and a plain-language description of the violation.

context.scope_limits: Assesses the report’s expressed qualification and relations, not the legal merits or truth of the conclusion.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively states a compliance conclusion as apparent, then identifies a legal provision and explains the associated violation; merely mentioning a provision or violation is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report retains the apparent or otherwise stated qualification, identifies the legal provision, and makes clear that the plain-language violation explanation relates to it without asserting an unreported adjudicated finding.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts this relation but presents the apparent conclusion as a definitive adjudicated finding, or leaves unclear how the provision and violation relate to that conclusion.

extensions.scope_limits: Assesses the report’s expressed qualification and relations, not the legal merits or truth of the conclusion.

skills.name: Generic aggregation or compression
skills.action: The observations describe combining selected related facts into concise prose, without a specific relation that can be assessed independently.

applicability.description: The observation describes aggregating selected case details, compressing them, or combining event, party, legal, and outcome information without specifying a distinctive relation among those details.

context.scope_limits: Preserves the aggregation observations without treating optional fact selection, sentence count, or concise wording as requirements. No omission of an optional fact is a failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: No eligible attempt definition: a general effort to combine or compress facts does not identify a single assessable relational operation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable. A coherent choice of which facts to combine is discretionary and is not assessed by this group.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable. These observations do not establish a report-observable pass/fail boundary beyond generic aggregation or compression.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserves the aggregation observations without treating optional fact selection, sentence count, or concise wording as requirements. No omission of an optional fact is a failure.

skills.name: Opening subject or document frame
skills.action: The observation describes introducing later details with a concise subject or document label.

applicability.description: The observation concerns placing a subject or document label before details as an opening frame.

context.scope_limits: Preserves the observed framing preference; does not require a particular opening, placement, or label.

evaluation.attempt_definition: No eligible attempt definition: choosing an opening position or introductory frame alone does not establish a nontrivial relation with a report-observable pass/fail boundary.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable. Whether to introduce the subject before associated details is an optional organizational choice.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable. The observation does not support an assessable failure criterion for opening placement.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserves the observed framing preference; does not require a particular opening, placement, or label.

skills.name: State repeated facts once
skills.action: When records repeat the same fact, state the shared fact once rather than reproducing redundant record-level entries.

applicability.description: The report positively presents the same substantive fact in multiple records or fields and attempts to consolidate it in the narrative.

context.scope_limits: Applies to repeated facts of the same role, including amounts, identities, and overlapping labels. Do not combine differing amounts, assessed and collected amounts, or other distinct categories; retain repetitions when separate contexts matter.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report explicitly signals that multiple entries share a fact or value, then states that fact as one consolidated narrative detail. Merely mentioning an amount or entity once does not establish an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear that the entries share the stated fact and gives it once in the relevant narrative context, without suggesting that distinct facts or monetary roles are equivalent.
evaluation.fail_definition: After attempting consolidation, the report repeats the same fact as though each repeated record supplied a separate substantive fact, or its wording makes the consolidated fact unclear. Repetition needed to distinguish contexts is not a failure.

extensions.scope_limits: Applies to repeated facts of the same role, including amounts, identities, and overlapping labels. Do not combine differing amounts, assessed and collected amounts, or other distinct categories; retain repetitions when separate contexts matter.

skills.name: Group participants under a shared matter
skills.action: Present parties or sites handled as one matter together, and summarize their shared scope while retaining material distinctions.

applicability.description: The report positively treats multiple parties or sites as participants in one enforcement matter and summarizes scope shared by those participants.

context.scope_limits: Does not require every party or site to be named or every record to be reproduced. Do not infer that all participants have identical attributes.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly groups multiple parties or sites under one matter and attempts to state their shared scope. Merely naming multiple parties, sites, or a case is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report identifies the participants as belonging to one matter and describes shared scope without erasing distinctions the report itself makes among them.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted grouping leaves unclear which parties or sites belong to the matter, or wording about shared scope conflates the common matter with characteristics the report itself distinguishes among participants.

extensions.scope_limits: Does not require every party or site to be named or every record to be reproduced. Do not infer that all participants have identical attributes.

skills.name: Quantify or describe a facility set
skills.action: Represent a supplied multi-facility set with a supported count or shared descriptor, and state its geographic grouping when that relation is included.

applicability.description: The report positively aggregates a supplied set of multiple facilities or repeated facility details by count, common descriptor, or geographic grouping.

context.scope_limits: Only assess an aggregate the report attempts to express. Do not require a count or geographic detail that the report does not choose to include, and do not infer attributes shared by every facility.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly represents multiple facilities or records as a set using a count or common descriptor, and, if attempted, relates that set to a geographic area. Merely mentioning facilities or a location is insufficient.
evaluation.pass_definition: The count or common descriptor clearly applies to the represented set, and any geographic description is scoped to that set without implying unsupported shared characteristics.
evaluation.fail_definition: The attempted aggregate gives internally inconsistent set membership or count, or wording attributes a geographic or other shared characteristic to every facility when the report itself does not support that scope.

extensions.scope_limits: Only assess an aggregate the report attempts to express. Do not require a count or geographic detail that the report does not choose to include, and do not infer attributes shared by every facility.

skills.name: Optional selection of summary details
skills.action: Select and compact case-event details for a summary while retaining the facts chosen for that account.

applicability.description: A report chooses a compact subset of details from a multi-field case record.

context.scope_limits: The observation sets no required length or mandatory facts. Omission of an optional detail is not a failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly presents selected event details as a compact summary; merely being brief does not establish this operation.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: different coherent selections or levels of detail are acceptable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: no objective report-observable failure follows from a discretionary choice of summary length or included facts.

extensions.scope_limits: The observation sets no required length or mandatory facts. Omission of an optional detail is not a failure.

skills.name: Optional broader entity description
skills.action: Describe an entity at the category or jurisdiction level when that is the chosen level of account.

applicability.description: A report chooses to describe an entity at a broader category or jurisdiction level rather than by individual name.

context.scope_limits: This records a level-of-description choice, not a requirement to omit names or a finding about why a name is absent.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report expressly chooses a category- or jurisdiction-level description in place of an individual entity name.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable: either a broader description or an individual name may be a coherent choice.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: the choice to generalize or omit an individual name has no objective pass/fail boundary here.

extensions.scope_limits: This records a level-of-description choice, not a requirement to omit names or a finding about why a name is absent.

skills.name: Attribute a date to the enforcement document
skills.action: When using a date in a document heading, identify it as the date of that document.

applicability.description: When a heading gives a date together with a specifically identified notice, order, agreement, or other enforcement document.

context.scope_limits: This is only the document-date relation. It does not require a dated heading, a particular opening position, or inclusion of other available title details; do not treat a case-closure or other milestone date as the document date without an expressed relation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses a date in a heading or title and positively presents it as belonging to the named document, not merely as an unqualified date near a document label.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear that the date is the date of the identified notice, order, agreement, or other document. Literal dates and document names may vary.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to date the document but leaves the date's role unclear or associates it with a different event; a bare date without an attempted document-date relation is not a failure.

extensions.scope_limits: This is only the document-date relation. It does not require a dated heading, a particular opening position, or inclusion of other available title details; do not treat a case-closure or other milestone date as the document date without an expressed relation.

skills.name: Attribute a date to the enforcement action
skills.action: When dating an enforcement action, state or clearly convey that the date belongs to the action.

applicability.description: When a heading dates an enforcement action itself, rather than merely naming a dated document.

context.scope_limits: Keep this distinct from a date of issuance or execution of a particular instrument and from a disposition or case-closure date. No heading or date is required when the report does not choose this operation.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report gives a date and positively identifies it as the date of the enforcement action.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report clearly relates the date to the enforcement action. The action label and literal date may vary.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to date the enforcement action but the stated relation is unclear or assigns the date to another event; simply placing a date beside an action label is not enough to establish an attempt if the relation is not expressed.

extensions.scope_limits: Keep this distinct from a date of issuance or execution of a particular instrument and from a disposition or case-closure date. No heading or date is required when the report does not choose this operation.

skills.name: Attribute a date to the disposition
skills.action: When identifying a disposition date, explicitly connect the date to the order, agreement, or other disposition.

applicability.description: When a heading presents a date as the date of a case disposition, such as an order or agreement resolving the matter.

context.scope_limits: This concerns only the date's event role. It does not require a disposition heading, a penalty result, or any other optional content.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses a date and positively presents it as the date of the disposition.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear that the date belongs to the disposition, rather than to a later closure milestone or another event.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts to give the disposition date but leaves its role unclear or presents it as the date of another event. Mentioning an order, agreement, penalty, or date separately does not by itself attempt this relation.

extensions.scope_limits: This concerns only the date's event role. It does not require a disposition heading, a penalty result, or any other optional content.

skills.name: Preserve allegation status in a title
skills.action: When a title summarizes alleged conduct, retain its allegation status in the wording.

applicability.description: When a title characterizes a principal issue as alleged conduct.

context.scope_limits: This rule assesses only the expressed allegation-versus-finding status. It does not require a title or determine which allegation should be selected.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The title describes an issue and positively presents that issue as alleged, rather than merely naming a notice or enforcement topic.
evaluation.pass_definition: The title clearly marks the described issue as alleged conduct and does not present that allegation as an established finding.
evaluation.fail_definition: The title attempts to characterize the issue as alleged but states it as an established finding, or leaves unclear whether it is an allegation or a finding. A topic label or a notice title alone is not an attempt.

extensions.scope_limits: This rule assesses only the expressed allegation-versus-finding status. It does not require a title or determine which allegation should be selected.

skills.name: Entity naming or heading placement
skills.action: Present a selected entity name as a heading or prominent identifier.

applicability.description: When a report uses headings or prominent identifiers for an organization, facility, case, activity, or party.

context.scope_limits: Preserves observations about entity headings and name selection. It does not establish which available name or party role should be preferred, or require a heading.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report presents an entity name as a heading, title, or prominent identifier.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: entity selection, naming, and placement alone do not create a report-observable relational transformation with a reliable pass/fail boundary here.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserves observations about entity headings and name selection. It does not establish which available name or party role should be preferred, or require a heading.

skills.name: Lexical label in a heading
skills.action: Render a supplied statute, program, enforcement-type, or instrument label concisely in a heading.

applicability.description: When a heading uses a statute, program, enforcement type, instrument label, or other supplied descriptor.

context.scope_limits: Preserves the observed heading-label transformations, including acronym and descriptor choices. It does not assess legal accuracy, require a heading, or create a rule from code expansion alone.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report places a supplied code, acronym, statute name, instrument label, or descriptive phrase in a heading.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: lexicalizing, abbreviating, or expanding a label by itself has no eligible relational pass/fail boundary in these observations.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserves the observed heading-label transformations, including acronym and descriptor choices. It does not assess legal accuracy, require a heading, or create a rule from code expansion alone.

skills.name: Topic, allegation, or section heading
skills.action: Use a heading or label to identify a report section or topic.

applicability.description: When a report labels a section or heading as concerning allegations, penalties, a law section, or another topic.

context.scope_limits: Preserves heading and count-label observations. A heading alone does not establish an allegation as a finding, state whether a penalty was assessed or collected, or require a particular section scheme.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses a heading, count label, or section label to identify a topic or allegation section.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: the section label, numbering, or topic name alone does not assert the status or substance of the material that follows.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserves heading and count-label observations. A heading alone does not establish an allegation as a finding, state whether a penalty was assessed or collected, or require a particular section scheme.

skills.name: Optional title content and opening arrangement
skills.action: Select and arrange matter details in a concise title or opening header.

applicability.description: When a report selects a short title, opening header, or subject line from multiple available matter details.

context.scope_limits: Preserves observations about title bundles, subject-line choices, and opening formats. Do not treat omitted optional facts, a different coherent selection, or a different opening position as a failure.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report selects, combines, foregrounds, or omits details in a title or opening header.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not applicable.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not applicable: these observations concern optional title content, compactness, or opening arrangement, not a required relational transformation.

extensions.scope_limits: Preserves observations about title bundles, subject-line choices, and opening formats. Do not treat omitted optional facts, a different coherent selection, or a different opening position as a failure.

skills.name: Make an identifier-to-matter association unambiguous
skills.action: When relating an identifier to a shipment or matter, state the association so the intended referent is clear.

applicability.description: A report explicitly associates a case or docket identifier with a shipment or other matter in narrative prose.

context.scope_limits: Do not validate the identifier against source data or require a particular identifier label. A mere identifier label without an entity association is outside scope.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses wording that positively links an identifier to a named shipment or matter; merely mentioning both is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The wording makes clear which named shipment or matter the identifier is associated with. This assesses the expressed association, not whether the identifier is factually correct.
evaluation.fail_definition: The wording attempts the association but leaves unclear which matter the identifier refers to, or conflates the identifier with an unclear participant.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not validate the identifier against source data or require a particular identifier label. A mere identifier label without an entity association is outside scope.

skills.name: Opening identification and metadata presentation
skills.action: Identify the relevant matter and present any selected case or docket identifier in the report's opening information.

applicability.description: A report identifies an order, action, subject, or matter in front matter or near its beginning.

context.scope_limits: Opening position, inclusion of an identifier, and inclusion of optional issuing or legal-basis details are not required. Do not enforce TRAIN dates or other source values.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively presents a matter or subject as an identified order, action, or case; simply placing a bare identifier somewhere in the text is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not scored. The observations record an opening identification or metadata presentation, not a required content or placement rule.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not scored as a transformation: the observations concern identification, labels, or placement, without a nontrivial report-observable relation that can be assessed independently of optional content choices.

extensions.scope_limits: Opening position, inclusion of an identifier, and inclusion of optional issuing or legal-basis details are not required. Do not enforce TRAIN dates or other source values.

skills.name: Identifier label and value presentation
skills.action: When displaying an identifier, pair it with a reader-facing label and render its selected value.

applicability.description: A report chooses to display a case, docket, file, shipment, or entry identifier as a labeled field or formatted value.

context.scope_limits: Parameterize identifier values, prefixes, and labels. Do not require a particular label, formatting convention, match to an input field, or inclusion of multiple identifiers.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report presents an identifier with a label or formats its value as a field; mentioning a matter without presenting an identifier is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not scored. A displayed label and identifier can be observed, but these observations do not establish a required label, format, or identifier selection.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not scored as a transformation: the observations concern naming, labeling, or formatting an identifier, with no independent relational boundary beyond those presentation choices.

extensions.scope_limits: Parameterize identifier values, prefixes, and labels. Do not require a particular label, formatting convention, match to an input field, or inclusion of multiple identifiers.

skills.name: Optional repetition of shipment identifiers
skills.action: When useful, repeat selected shipment identifiers in a later particulars section after giving them in opening metadata.

applicability.description: A report gives a compact set of shipment identifiers and also repeats them in a later details section.

context.scope_limits: Do not require repetition or penalize a coherent report that gives the information only once.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report positively presents the same identifying information in an opening location and a later detailed location; one presentation alone is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: Not scored. The observation records repeated identifiers but does not establish that repetition is needed or required.
evaluation.fail_definition: Not scored as a transformation: repetition is an optional coverage and organization choice, not a required relation or ordering operation.

extensions.scope_limits: Do not require repetition or penalize a coherent report that gives the information only once.

skills.name: Link an opening matter to its later particulars
skills.action: Use a clear referent to connect an opening identification with the later section that gives that matter's particulars.

applicability.description: A report first identifies a matter and then directs readers to a later section containing its particulars.

context.scope_limits: Assess only the clarity of the expressed cross-section link. Do not require a cross-reference, a particular phrase, or any optional details.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report uses an explicit referential expression to connect the opening matter with a later particulars section; merely placing two sections in the same report is not an attempt.
evaluation.pass_definition: The cross-reference makes clear that the later particulars concern the same matter identified earlier.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts the cross-reference, but its wording leaves the referenced matter or later particulars ambiguous, so readers cannot tell what the later section describes.

extensions.scope_limits: Assess only the clarity of the expressed cross-section link. Do not require a cross-reference, a particular phrase, or any optional details.

skills.name: Actor-to-selected-action attribution
skills.action: Connect a selected enforcement or violation action to its actor or affected participant, keeping acting agency, regulated party and affected object distinct.

evaluation.attempt_definition: A report predicate assigns or attempts to assign a selected act, assertion or event to an actor or affected participant; passive constructions are eligible.
evaluation.pass_definition: The selected predicate and its participant roles are recoverable and consistently linked across the wording actually used.
evaluation.fail_definition: An attempted selected predicate has ambiguous, conflicting or missing participant linkage in the report; an entirely unselected actor or event is not required.

skills.name: Descriptor-to-selected-subject attachment
skills.action: Attach a selected violation, regulatory, instrument or conduct descriptor to the precise object, conduct or event it characterizes, preserving that descriptor’s semantic scope.

evaluation.attempt_definition: A report uses a substantive category/descriptor with a selected object, act or event, or visibly attempts such characterization.
evaluation.pass_definition: The report makes clear what the chosen descriptor characterizes and does not conflate a program, legal instrument, conduct, status or affected object.
evaluation.fail_definition: The report attempts characterization but leaves its subject unresolved or expresses a conflicting category/role attachment; no unseen truth or unselected descriptor is checked.

skills.name: Qualifier scope within selected propositions
skills.action: Preserve the scope of selected assertion-state, event-state, restrictive or multi-part qualifiers on the proposition or noun phrase they modify.

evaluation.attempt_definition: The report actually qualifies a selected proposition or substantive noun phrase, including assertion/event state or restrictive category modifiers.
evaluation.pass_definition: The expressed qualifier modifies its intended selected proposition or entity without ambiguous attachment, conflicting scope or self-contradiction.
evaluation.fail_definition: A chosen qualifier is expressed but its report-internal scope is unresolved, reversed or conflicts with the report’s other wording; absence of an optional qualifier is not failure.

rewriting.title: Rewriting
rewriting.purpose: Improve wording, structure, and presentation while preserving source meaning and necessary information.

skills.name: Use a familiar location word for a relative location
skills.action: When a source uses a multiword relative-location phrase, a shorter familiar location word may express the same relationship if it still clearly identifies where the referenced event occurred.

all_of: The source contains a relative clause locating an event or condition in a place.
The location relationship is clear without relying on a specialized or defined term.

preserve: The event whose location is specified
The relationship between that event and the place

records.abstract_quote: in which the data was originally collected
records.adaptation_quote: where the data was originally collected

skills.name: Frame the request as carrying the requirement
skills.action: When the source directly instructs the reader to provide information as part of making or submitting a request, frame the requirement as one the request must meet. Keep the required act and its purpose clear.

all_of: The source directly instructs the reader to provide information or take an action.
The action is part of making or submitting a request.
exclude_if: The source assigns the action to someone other than the reader.

preserve: The requirement to provide information for the stated purpose.

records.abstract_quote: Provide sufficient information
records.adaptation_quote: Your request to Us must provide sufficient information

skills.name: Use a possessive to identify the information’s subject
skills.action: When the source refers to information associated with the reader using a noun phrase plus a separate phrase identifying the reader, you may use a possessive form to make that relationship more direct.

all_of: The source identifies information as being about or associated with a person.
The person is already identifiable from the surrounding statement.

preserve: The information is associated with the reader.

records.abstract_quote: personal information about you
records.adaptation_quote: your personal information

skills.name: State the available choice directly
skills.action: When the source describes a person’s ability to make a choice through an indirect opportunity formulation, you may state the choice directly, provided the same choice remains available.

all_of: The source describes an opportunity for a person to make a choice.
The surrounding text identifies what choice is available.

preserve: The reader can choose not to share the information.

records.abstract_quote: will have an opportunity to choose not to share the information
records.adaptation_quote: can choose not to share the information

skills.name: State the available control as a direct action
skills.action: When a source explains that a person can avoid a practice by taking a stated action, consider describing the action directly as the way to achieve that outcome, rather than framing it as a refusal made by taking the action.

all_of: The source presents declining or avoiding a stated practice as an available option.
The source explicitly links a specified action to carrying out that option.

preserve: The user's option to decline the stated practice and the specified means for doing so

records.abstract_quote: You may refuse the use of cookies by selecting the appropriate settings on your browser to decline cookies.
records.adaptation_quote: You can select the appropriate settings on your browser to decline cookies.

skills.name: Use parallel action verbs in an activity list
skills.action: When a source lists coordinated activities as gerunds, use parallel action verbs if the surrounding sentence supports that construction. Keep each activity paired with its stated object.

all_of: The source contains a coordinated list of activities expressed as gerunds.
The sentence supports a parallel verb construction without changing the activities or their relationships.
exclude_if: Changing the verb forms would make an activity’s actor, object, or relationship to the other activities unclear or different.

preserve: The listed activities and their stated objects.

records.abstract_quote: measuring our ad performance and conversion, optimizing our ad campaigns, and showing you personalized and non-personalized ads
records.adaptation_quote: measure our ad performance and conversion, optimize our ad campaigns, and show you personalized and non-personalized ads

skills.name: Omit nonessential placement detail in a high-level description
skills.action: For a high-level explanation of a practice, omit a placement detail only when the explanation does not need to specify where the described item appears; do not imply a narrower placement scope.

all_of: The source specifies where a described item or practice occurs.
The rewrite omits that location detail while retaining the underlying practice.
exclude_if: The location is necessary to distinguish the practice or its scope, or the rewrite implies a different placement.

preserve: The practice of showing personalized and non-personalized ads.

records.abstract_quote: showing you personalized and non-personalized ads on or off of the Services
records.adaptation_quote: show you personalized and non-personalized ads

skills.name: Lead with the capability, not its route
skills.action: State the supported capability directly, without an introductory phrase naming a means or place, when that route is not essential to the explanation. Keep the stated action and its object clear.

all_of: The source introduces a user capability with a phrase naming a means or place through which the capability can be exercised.
The capability can be explained independently of that route.
exclude_if: The source makes the named route an exclusive means or a necessary condition for the capability.

preserve: The stated ability to correct and change the selected personal-information category.
The association between that information and the user's account.

records.abstract_quote: By visiting your account settings, you can correct and change certain personal information associated with your account.
records.adaptation_quote: You can correct and change certain personal information associated with your account.

skills.name: Replace a relational phrase with a compact category label
skills.action: When a source identifies a category through a short relational phrase, consider using a compact category label if the relationship remains clear in context.

all_of: The source describes information using a phrase that links it to an entity.
The surrounding text makes the intended link between the information and that entity clear.

preserve: The stated relationship between the information and the entity.

records.abstract_quote: may collect data associated with a device to determine the country from which the device is accessing the Services
records.adaptation_quote: may collect device data to determine the country from which the device is accessing the Services

skills.name: Make the reader’s choice the main clause
skills.action: When a source describes a service-provided item through a relative clause about what the reader may choose, you may recast the reader as the sentence’s subject and make the item the object of that choice. Keep the choice and the item being chosen clear.

all_of: The source describes a reader choosing whether to receive an item provided by the service.
The source states the reader’s choice within a clause attached to the item.

preserve: The reader may choose whether to receive the stated item.

records.abstract_quote: We provide a free, optional newsletter that parents can elect to receive
records.adaptation_quote: parents can elect a newsletter to receive

skills.name: Avoid a redundant website label before an address
skills.action: When a source gives a web address after a generic website label, you may omit the label if the remaining wording still identifies the address as the location for the stated action.

all_of: The source names a website as a location and gives its address immediately after a generic website label.
exclude_if: The label provides information needed to distinguish the address from other kinds of destination or channel.

preserve: The stated web address is the location for submitting the request.

records.abstract_quote: on our website at www.yateland.net.com
records.adaptation_quote: on www.yateland.net.com

skills.name: Turn a practice label and category fragment into a direct sentence
skills.action: When a heading identifies who performs a practice and a following fragment names the information involved, you may combine them into a direct sentence that states the relationship between the actor, practice, and information.

all_of: The source presents a heading-like phrase identifying an actor and practice.
A nearby fragment names information covered by that practice.

preserve: The actor identified as collecting
The collection practice
The information category named in the fragment
The relationship to the person described as having information collected about them

records.abstract_quote: **Information we collect about you** Internet and other electronic network activity information.
records.adaptation_quote: We collect Internet and other electronic network activity information about you.

skills.name: State the practice directly from the service perspective
skills.action: Turn a heading-like fragment that identifies information by how a user supplies it into a direct sentence stating the service's corresponding handling action.

all_of: The source is a heading or fragment describing information a user discloses or provides to a service.
A direct statement of the service's corresponding handling of that information is supported by the source.

preserve: The selected information category.
The user-to-service information flow.

records.abstract_quote: **Personal information you disclose to us**
records.adaptation_quote: We collect the personal information you provide.

skills.name: Use a familiar verb for supplying information
skills.action: Replace a formal or less familiar verb for sharing information with a common verb that expresses supplying information, while keeping the actor and recipient relationship clear in context.

all_of: The source uses a relatively formal verb for a user supplying information to a service.
A more familiar verb can describe the same user-to-service action in context.
exclude_if: The source verb carries a limiting or legally significant meaning that the proposed plain-language verb would not preserve.

preserve: The user's action of supplying the information to the service.

records.abstract_quote: **Personal information you disclose to us**
records.adaptation_quote: We collect the personal information you provide.

skills.name: Make an implicit category definition explicit
skills.action: When a compact label followed by a criterion leaves their relationship implicit, state the relationship directly so readers can see what category the criterion defines.

all_of: The source gives a category or label followed by a criterion in compressed form.
The surrounding source supports reading the criterion as defining that category.

preserve: the population or condition to which the definition applies
the stated criterion defining the category

records.abstract_quote: Residents of the UK: anyone under 13 years old.
records.adaptation_quote: Residents of the UK: anyone under 13 years old is a child.

skills.name: Let the conjunction carry a clear alternative
skills.action: Remove a contrastive adverb when the conjunction already makes the second action a clear alternative, so readers can follow the alternatives more directly.

all_of: The source presents two actions as alternatives and uses an adverb to distinguish the second action from the first.

preserve: The second action is an alternative to the first, not a step that requires it.

records.abstract_quote: or otherwise interact
records.adaptation_quote: or interact

skills.name: Use a direct demonstrative for a clear backward reference
skills.action: Use a direct demonstrative instead of a formal one when its antecedent is clear, helping readers connect the information to the preceding action.

all_of: The source uses a formal demonstrative to refer back to information already mentioned in the same sentence.

preserve: The reference to the information involved in the preceding action.

records.abstract_quote: such information
records.adaptation_quote: that information

skills.name: Use the named category as the explicit subject
skills.action: When a sentence begins with an anaphoric label for a category named immediately beforehand, an allowed alternative is to use that category name as the sentence subject. This can make the actor explicit without changing which category performs the stated action.

all_of: The source names a category immediately before a sentence about that category.
The sentence refers to the category anaphorically, rather than naming it as the subject.

preserve: The named category remains the actor associated with the stated action.

records.abstract_quote: Targeting Cookies These cookies collect
records.adaptation_quote: Targeting Cookies collect

skills.name: Use a compact age-threshold phrase
skills.action: Replace a formal age-threshold phrase with a shorter, familiar construction when it retains the same threshold and category.

all_of: The source describes a group using the construction “under the age of” followed by an age threshold.
The adaptation expresses that threshold more compactly.
exclude_if: The shorter form changes the threshold or makes the covered group ambiguous.

preserve: the age threshold defining the covered group

records.abstract_quote: from a user under the age of 18
records.adaptation_quote: from users under 18

skills.name: Use a digit for a spelled-out duration numeral
skills.action: When a duration is written with a spelled-out numeral, an allowed alternative is to use a digit while keeping the unit and threshold relationship clear.

all_of: The source excerpts contain extended quoted argument, testimony, or legislative material relevant to the reported issue.

preserve: If a quotation’s proposition is retained, preserve its meaning and any qualification material to the holding.
This convention concerns the quoted exposition shown in the source excerpts; it does not establish that all quotations or authorities should be omitted.

skills.name: Leave out nonessential numerical detail
skills.action: Omit fine-grained amounts, measurements, and administrative figures when they are background details rather than quantities needed to state the summarized result.

all_of: The source provides specific amounts, measurements, or administrative figures beyond those needed to state the dispute or result.

preserve: Retain quantities, dates, or thresholds that define the legal rule, the relevant time period, or the result when the summary reports those matters.
If a figure is retained, state it consistently with the source.

skills.name: Omit separate dissenting views
